Greetings of love in Jesus’ name! We have a great God who is worthy of all our praise, all our love, and our whole life!

We live in a time where there are many distractions. The prince of this world is truly out to destroy people’s lives at whatever cost. We have amusement parks, video arcades, theaters, internet, Facebook, fashion malls, and whatever else you can think of—it’s out there. But God would have our hearts stirred to not be entangled with these distractions, but rather to work for Him and His Kingdom. If we are entangled with the affairs of this life, we will have no time left for our Lord. We cannot serve two masters. There seem to be some things trying to steal the time of our dear sisters (young and old alike). Let us be aware of these things so that we can be free from them and then be free to serve the Lord with our whole hearts.

The one thing we should be aware of is called adornment and the other is foolishness or looseness. To me it is so amazing how God works. He tells us in His Word what not to adorn ourselves with, but He also tells us what to adorn ourselves with. He tells us what fruit should be coming from our lives, and what fruit should not be coming from our lives. For every evil way that there is, God also shows us the right way. I know many of us would not go to fashion malls to buy our clothes, but I fear that many of us are still looking for clothes that accent the body rather than glorify our Lord. Jesus said: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God –Matthew 5:8.

Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel; But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price. For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement –1 Peter 3:3-6.

Adorn: to deck or beautify; set off; to embellish by anything external or adventitious; to display the beauty or excellence of.

Remember, God wants us to adorn ourselves with things that will bring glory to Him. Depending on the type of clothing that I choose to wear, the focus of others is drawn to my clothing first, instead of my countenance. When this happens then I am getting all the glory because the focus is on my apparel. But if somebody sees me and they can see the clear countenance on my face and they can tell that I’ve been with Jesus, then they will give God all the glory that He deserves, and we will be displaying the beauty or excellence of God’s spirit in our lives.

Now let’s take a look at some more of the words found in our Scripture text and consider their meaning:

Plaiting: folding, doubling, braiding.

Apparel: clothing; external habiliments or decorations.

Ornament: That which embellishes; or something which, added to another thing, renders it most beautiful to the eye.

How beautiful it is to our Lord when we become born again, have a broken spirit, and become meek and quiet. Can people see the fruits of God’s spirit in our lives—as ornaments? Truly that is an ornament of great price. Remember we can add external ornaments to our lives that bring sadness to our Father. Let us not make Him ashamed to call us His sons and daughters.

Meek: mild of temper; soft; gentle; not easily provoked or irritated; yielding, given to forbearance under injuries.

Are we irritated if somebody has something to share with us that will help us in our walk with the Lord? Remember our Lord wants the fruit of meekness adorning our converted lives.

Quiet: still; being in a state of rest; not moving; peaceable; not turbulent; not giving offence; not exciting controversy, disorder, or trouble; mild; meek; contented.

With every new style that comes in among us are we quick to change for no reason other than adding something to our bodies that only brings glory to us? Are we content with the biblical standard of God for our lives? Are we firm and grounded in what we believe? Do we know why we believe in what we believe?

Subjection: the act of subduing; the act of vanquishing and bringing under the dominion of another.

Are we under the dominion of our Lord in every aspect of our lives?

Afraid: impressed with fear or apprehension.

Amazement: astonishment; confusion or perplexity from a sudden impression of fear, surprise, or wonder.

We are daughters of Sarah as long as we do well, and are not impressed with fear or any confusion or perplexity. God is not the author of confusion—The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul… –Psalm 19:7. Remember: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom [not confusion]… –Proverbs 9:10.

Entangleth: to twist or interweave in such a manner as not to be easily separated; to perplex or distract, as with cares.

Are we allowing our lives to be interwoven with the fashions and foolishness of this world?

No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier. But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness. Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart –2 Timothy 2:4-22.

Shun: to avoid; to keep clear of; not to fall on or come in contact with; not to mix or associate with.

Are we shunning the practices of this world? More specifically, are we shunning loose and empty talk?

Profane: irreverent to anything sacred; polluted; not pure.

Vain: empty; worthless; having no substance, value, or importance.

What we fill ourselves with will come out. If we are filling ourselves with God’s holy Word, then that will be flowing out of our lives. However, if we are filling ourselves with vain things then that shall come out as well.

Babblings: foolish talk.

Is our talk centered on the Bible, or is it centered on the new things that we have bought such as a new garment or a vehicle, or maybe it’s on all the people we have met on Facebook?

Flee: to run with rapidity, as from danger; to hasten from danger; or expected evil.

If we are with a group of people whose talk is foolish, do we stay for fear of losing friends or do we walk (or run) away from the expected or dangerous evil? The more we interweave our lives with the ways of the world, the harder it is to untangle ourselves.

Lusts: longing desire; eagerness to possess or enjoy; carnal appetite; unlawful desire of carnal pleasure.

God will give us the true desires of our heart. We may say that we desire pure things, but if our heart is yearning for unlawful things, we shall yield to those things. Our lives consist not only in what we say, but more importantly what we live. Also, take courage, the inward desires of our heart can be forever changed through the spiritual operation or “new birth”.

Righteousness: the active and passive obedience of Christ, by which the law of God is fulfilled.

If we are to follow righteousness, then that means we should follow the active and passive obedience that Christ shows us by his example.

Faith: the object of belief; a doctrine or system of doctrines believed.

What is the reality of our faith? Do we really believe God and what He tells us through His written Word? It was because Abraham believed God that he was able to “offer up” his only son Isaac through whom Abraham’s descendants would be counted. –see Hebrews 11:17 and Genesis 22:13. If God tells us in His Word to shun ungodliness because it will lead to more ungodliness, then we need to believe God and flee those things, and we must not allow ourselves to think that just a little bit of fun will not matter.

Charity: love; benevolence; goodwill; that disposition of the heart which inclines men to think favorably of their fellow men, and to do them good; it includes supreme love to God our Maker and universal good will to men.

Do we have the Love of God dwelling within and flowing out of our lives like a spring of running water?

Peace: heavenly rest; harmony; freedom from disturbance or agitation.

We are to follow the example of our dear Savior Jesus Christ whose whole life was in perfect harmony with God the Father. Christ was not disturbed or disrupted by the ways of this world, but He was at rest doing His Father’s will. Are we?

Pure: clear; free from moral defilement; without spot; holy; incorrupt.

We are to follow or have these fruits adorned in our lives and also practicing these with those who are practicing the same things in their own lives. A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array; But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works –1 Timothy 2:9-10.

Shamefacedness: bashfulness; excess of modesty.

We should be adorned with shamefacedness and not giddiness or sensuality.

Sobriety: habitual soberness; seriousness; gravity without sadness or melancholy.

Even if we are sober we don’t need to be sad but we can have the joy of the Lord adorning our lives. There should be a light in our eyes because Jesus is the light of our lives. Truly if God’s spirit is dwelling within us we have so much to be thankful for. It should be evident in every aspect of our lives.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men, Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world –Titus 2:11-12.

I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels –Isaiah 61:10.

The ornaments of modesty, shamefacedness, sobriety, faith, charity, peace, righteousness, meekness, and quietness are truly jewels of great price. These jewels are so valuable that it is worth surrendering our whole lives to the God of Heaven, our Maker, and our Redeemer, so that we may have them adorning our lives. But likewise, if we are surrendered to the god of this world we will have the ornaments of pride, envy, hate, jealousy, and so forth. Which ones are the more beautiful?

And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband. And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God. –Revelation 21:2-3.

Are we preparing to meet Jesus? Is God dwelling in us? Is He our God and are we His people?

Remember time is swiftly passing by. We can be here today and gone tomorrow. Do we want to be with Jesus throughout all eternity, or do we want to be with the devil and his angels? The choices we make for our lives today will affect where we spend eternity.

Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap –Galatians 6:7. Don’t be misled. That verse is also for the believer, not just for the unconverted. Each one of us can ask ourselves what we are sowing. Concerning adornment, are we sowing the thought that outward beauty is very important or are we sowing the thought that inward beauty is the most precious thing to have and obtain? For clarification, I am not talking about being dirty and unkempt. God is a God of order and cleanliness, but He is not a God of ribbons, bows, frills, lace, and expensive, attractive clothing. Remember that most people who create new clothing fashions focus on designing garments so that they will be appealing and attractive to the eye. That is what makes people buy them.

Again, when people look at us do they glorify our fleshly body or are they praising God for the work that He is doing in our lives? Also, concerning foolishness and looseness, if we are grounded in the word of God, we will not have time for vain babblings and pleasure-seeking idleness. Let us be busy doing the work of our Lord, such as helping our neighbor who could use an extra hand, or sharing our testimony with people that we meet.

And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell –Matthew 10:28. As we live in these last times, the message that is all around us is that as long as you believe in a God, you will be okay. That is a false message. Jesus tells us there is only one way. Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him –John 14:6-7. Praise the Lord that God has given us an example to follow.

Gegroet in de liefde in Jezus' naam! Wij hebben een geweldige God die alle lof, alle liefde en ons hele leven waardig is!

We leven in een tijd met vele afleidingen. De overste van deze wereld probeert werkelijk ieders leven te vernietigen, koste wat het kost. We hebben pretparken, videogameshallen, theaters, internet, Facebook, modecentra en wat je maar kunt bedenken—het is er allemaal. Maar God wil dat onze harten worden geroerd om ons niet in te laten met deze afleidingen, maar om voor Hem en Zijn Koninkrijk te werken. Als we verstrikt raken in de zorgen van dit leven, zullen we geen tijd meer overhouden voor onze Heere. Wij kunnen niet twee heren dienen. Het lijkt erop dat er dingen zijn die de tijd van onze dierbare zusters (jong en oud) proberen te stelen. Laten we ons bewust zijn van deze dingen zodat we ervan vrij kunnen zijn en dan vrij zijn om de Heere met ons hele hart te dienen.

Het ene waarvan wij ons bewust moeten zijn heet sieraad, en het andere is dwaasheid of losbandigheid. Het is voor mij zo verbazingwekkend hoe God werkt. Hij zegt ons in Zijn Woord waarmee wij ons niet moeten tooien, maar Hij vertelt ons ook waarmee wij ons wel moeten tooien. Hij zegt welke vrucht uit ons leven zou moeten voortkomen, en welke vrucht er niet uit zou moeten voortkomen. Voor elke kwaadaardige weg die er is, toont God ons ook de juiste weg. Ik weet dat velen van ons niet naar modecentra gaan om onze kleding te kopen, maar ik vrees dat velen van ons nog steeds op zoek zijn naar kleding die het lichaam accentueert in plaats van onze Heere te verheerlijken. Jezus zei: Zalig zijn de reinen van hart; want zij zullen God zien – Mattheüs 5:8.

Uw tooi zij niet de uiterlijke vlecht van het haar, noch het ophangen van gouden sieraden, noch het dragen van rijke kleding; maar de verborgen mens des harten, in vergankelijke siervoorziening, dat is de zachtmoedige en stille geest, die in Gods ogen zeer kostbaar is. Want alzo tooiden zich ook de heilige vrouwen, die hun hoop op God gesteld hadden, zijnde onderdanig aan hun mannen; gelijk Sara gehoorzaamde Abraham, hem noemende heer: aan wie u kinderen zijt, zo gij het goede doet en u niet laat verschrikken door enige vrees – 1 Petrus 3:3-6.

Adorners: verhullen of verfraaien; opleuken; verfraaien door iets uitwendigs of toevalligs; de schoonheid of uitmuntendheid tonen van.

Herinner u, God wil dat wij ons tooien met dingen die Hem verheerlijken. Afhankelijk van het soort kleding dat ik kies te dragen, wordt de aandacht van anderen eerst naar mijn kleding getrokken, in plaats van naar mijn gelaat. Wanneer dit gebeurt, krijg ik alle lof omdat de aandacht op mijn kleding is. Maar als iemand mij ziet en men kan het duidelijke gelaat op mijn gezicht zien en men kan zeggen dat ik bij Jezus ben geweest, dan zullen zij God alle lof geven die Hij verdient, en zullen wij de schoonheid of uitmuntendheid van Gods Geest in ons leven tonen.

Laten we nu eens kijken naar enkele woorden in onze Schrifttekst en hun betekenis overwegen:

Plaiting: vouwen, verdubbelen, vlechten.

Apparel: kleding; uitwendige klederen of versierselen.

Ornament: Dat wat verfraait; of iets dat, toegevoegd aan iets anders, het meest schoon voor het oog maakt.

Hoe mooi is het voor onze Heere wanneer wij wedergeboren worden, een gebroken geest hebben en zachtmoedig en stil worden. Kunnen mensen de vruchten van Gods Geest in ons leven zien—als sieraden? Waarlijk, dat is een sieraad van grote waarde. Onthoud dat we uitwendige versierselen aan ons leven kunnen toevoegen die onze Vader bedroeven. Laten we Hem niet beschaamd maken om ons Zijnen te noemen.

Meek: zacht van gemoed; zachtaardig; niet gemakkelijk geprikkeld of geïrriteerd; inschikkelijk, geneigd tot geduld bij krenkingen.

Worden we geïrriteerd als iemand iets met ons deelt dat ons zou helpen in onze wandel met de Heere? Onthoud dat onze Heere de vrucht van zachtmoedigheid in ons bekeerde leven wil zien tooien.

Quiet: stil; in een staat van rust zijnde; niet bewegend; vredig; niet ontwrichtend; geen aanstoot gevend; geen controverse, wanorde of moeite opwekkend; zacht; zachtaardig; tevreden.

Bij elke nieuwe stijl die bij ons komt, veranderen we dan snel zonder andere reden dan iets aan ons lichaam toe te voegen dat slechts onszelf verheerlijkt? Zijn we tevreden met Gods goddelijke norm voor ons leven? Zijn we vast en gegrond in wat we geloven? Weten we waarom we geloven wat we geloven?

Subjection: de handeling van onderwerpen; de daad van overwinnen en onder de heerschappij van een ander brengen.

Zijn wij onder de heerschappij van onze Heere in elk aspect van ons leven?

Afraid: getroffen door vrees of bezorgdheid.

Amazement: verwondering; verwarring of perplexiteit door een plotselinge indruk van vrees, verrassing of wonder.

Wij zijn dochters van Sara, zolang wij goed doen en ons niet laten indrukken door vrees of enige verwarring of perplexiteit. God is niet de auteur van verwarring—De wet des HEREN is volmaakt, die de ziel wederbrengt… – Psalm 19:7. Onthoud: De vreze des HEREN is het begin der wijsheid [niet verwarring] … – Spreuken 9:10.

Entangleth: verstrikken, zodanig in elkaar draaien of verweven dat het niet gemakkelijk te scheiden is; verwarren of afleiden, zoals met zorgen.

Laten we ons leven verweven met de mode en dwaasheid van deze wereld?

Geen soldaat, die strijdt, verstrikt zich in de zorgen van dit leven, opdat hij Hem moge behagen, die hem tot soldaat gesteld heeft. En vermijdt onheilige en ijdele babbels; want zij zullen in goddeloosheid voortgaan. Vlucht ook de jongelingsgepassionneerdheden; maar volg de gerechtigheid, het geloof, de liefde, de vrede, met degenen die de Heere aanroepen uit een rein hart – 2 Timoteüs 2:4-22.

Shun: vermijden; uit de weg blijven; niet op stuiten of in aanraking komen met; niet mengen of omgaan met.

Vermijden wij de gebruiken van deze wereld? Meer specifiek, mijden wij losse en lege praat?

Profane: oneerbiedig tegenover alles heiligs; bezoedeld; niet rein.

Vain: ijdel; leeg; zonder substantie, waarde of belangrijkheid.

Wat we onszelf voeden zal naar buiten komen. Als wij ons vullen met Gods heilig Woord, dan zal dat uit ons leven stromen. Maar als wij ons vullen met ijdele dingen, dan zal dat ook naar buiten komen.

Babblings: dwaas gepraat.

Is ons gesprek gecentreerd op de Bijbel, of draait het om de nieuwe dingen die we hebben gekocht zoals een nieuw kledingstuk of een voertuig, of misschien om alle mensen die we op Facebook hebben ontmoet?

Flee: vluchten met snelheid, alsof van gevaar; haasten van gevaar of verwacht kwaad.

Als we bij een groep mensen zijn wier praat dwaas is, blijven we dan uit angst vrienden te verliezen, of lopen we (of rennen we) weg van het verwachte of gevaarlijke kwaad? Hoe meer we ons leven verweven met de wegen van de wereld, hoe moeilijker het is onszelf te ontwarren.

Lusts: hevig verlangen; ijver om te bezitten of te genieten; carnale eetlust; onwettig verlangen naar lichamelijk genot.

God zal ons de ware begeerten van ons hart geven. We kunnen zeggen dat we zuivere dingen verlangen, maar als ons hart verlangt naar onwettige dingen, zullen we eraan toegeven. Ons leven bestaat niet alleen uit wat we zeggen, maar belangrijker wat we leven. Wees ook bemoedigd: de innerlijke begeerten van ons hart kunnen voor altijd veranderd worden door de geestelijke werking of "wedergeboorte".

Righteousness: de actieve en passieve gehoorzaamheid van Christus, waardoor Gods wet vervuld wordt.

Als wij de gerechtigheid volgen, dan betekent dat dat wij de actieve en passieve gehoorzaamheid die Christus ons door Zijn voorbeeld toont, moeten volgen.

Faith: het object van geloof; een leer of een systeem van dogma's geloofd.

Wat is de realiteit van ons geloof? Geloven wij werkelijk God en wat Hij ons zegt door Zijn geschreven Woord? Het was omdat Abraham God geloofde dat hij in staat was zijn eniggeboren zoon Isaac op te offeren, door wie Abrahams nakomelingen gerekend zouden worden. – zie Hebreeën 11:17 en Genesis 22:13. Als God ons in Zijn Woord zegt de goddeloosheid te mijden omdat het tot meer goddeloosheid leidt, dan moeten wij God geloven en van die dingen vluchten, en onszelf niet toestaan te denken dat een klein beetje plezier geen kwaad kan.

Charity: liefde; welwillendheid; goedgunstigheid; die gesteldheid van het hart die mensen geneigd maakt goed van hun medemensen te denken en hun goed te doen; het omvat de hoogste liefde tot God, onze Maker, en algemene welwillendheid jegens mensen.

Wonen de liefde van God in ons en stroomt zij uit ons leven als een bron van stromend water?

Peace: hemelse rust; harmonie; vrij zijn van verstoring of onrust.

Wij moeten het voorbeeld volgen van onze dierbare Heiland Jezus Christus, wiens hele leven in volmaakte harmonie met God de Vader stond. Christus liet zich niet verstoren of ontwrichten door de wijzen van deze wereld, maar Hij was in rust terwijl Hij de wil van Zijn Vader deed. Zijn wij dat ook?

Pure: helder; vrij van morele bezoedeling; zonder vlek; heilig; onvergankelijk.

Wij moeten deze vruchten in ons leven toegetooid hebben en ook oefenen met degenen die dezelfde dingen in hun leven beoefenen. Een beetje zuurdesem maakt de hele bulle zuur.

Gelijk ook moeten de vrouwen zichzelf tooien in zedelijke kleding, met schaamte en soberheid; niet met gevlochten haar, noch met goud, noch met parels, noch met kostuumlijk vertoon; maar (wat vrouwen betaamt die godsvrucht belijden) met goede werken – 1 Timoteüs 2:9-10.

Shamefacedness: verlegenheid; overdreven bescheidenheid.

Wij zouden getooid moeten zijn met schaamte, niet met luchtigheid of zinnelijkheid.

Sobriety: gewone nuchterheid; ernst; waardigheid zonder droefheid of melancholie.

Zelfs als wij nuchter zijn, hoeven we niet verdrietig te zijn; wij kunnen de blijdschap van de Heere hebben die ons leven tooit. Er zou licht in onze ogen moeten zijn omdat Jezus het licht van ons leven is. Waarlijk, als Gods Geest in ons woont, hebben we zo veel om dankbaar voor te zijn. Het moet in elk aspect van ons leven zichtbaar zijn.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

Want de genade Gods, die heil gebragt heeft voor alle mensen, heeft zich geopenbaard, lerende ons dat wij, de goddeloosheid en de wereldse begeerten verwerpend, sober, rechtvaardig en godzaliglijk zouden leven in deze tegenwoordige wereld – Titus 2:11-12.

Ik zal zeer verheugen in de HEERE, mijn ziel zal zich verblijden in mijn God; want Hij heeft mij aangekleed met de klederen des heils, Hij heeft mij omgord met de mantel der gerechtigheid, als een bruidegom zich tooit met sierraden, en als een bruid zich tooit met haar juwelen – Jesaja 61:10.

De sieraden van bescheidenheid, schaamte, soberheid, geloof, liefde, vrede, gerechtigheid, zachtmoedigheid en stilte zijn waarlijk juwelen van grote waarde. Deze juwelen zijn zo kostbaar dat het de moeite waard is ons hele leven over te geven aan de God des hemels, onze Maker en Verlosser, zodat wij ze in ons leven kunnen dragen. Maar evenzo, als wij overgeleverd zijn aan de god van deze wereld, zullen wij de sieraden van trots, afgunst, haat, jaloezie, enzovoort dragen. Welke zijn het mooist?

En ik, Johannes, zag de heilige stad, het Nieuwe Jeruzalem, neerdalen van God uit de hemel, gereedgemaakt als een bruid, siervrij gemaakt voor haar man. En ik hoorde een grote stem uit den hemel zeggende: Zie, de tabernakel Gods is bij de mensen, en Hij zal bij hen wonen, en zij zullen Zijn volk zijn, en God Zelf zal bij hen zijn, en hun God – Openbaring 21:2-3.

Bereiden wij ons voor om Jezus te ontmoeten? Woonde God in ons? Is Hij onze God en zijn wij Zijn volk?

Herinner u dat de tijd snel voorbijgaat. Wij kunnen er vandaag zijn en morgen verdwenen. Willen wij eeuwig bij Jezus zijn, of willen wij bij de duivel en zijn engelen zijn? De keuzes die we vandaag voor ons leven maken, zullen beïnvloeden waar wij de eeuwigheid doorbrengen.

Laat u niet misleiden; God laat Zich niet bespotten: want wat de mens zaait, zal hij ook maaien – Galaten 6:7. Wees niet misleid. Die tekst is ook voor de gelovige, niet alleen voor de onbekeerde. Ieder van ons kan zich afvragen wat we zaaien. Met betrekking tot tooi, zaaien wij de gedachte dat uitwendige schoonheid zeer belangrijk is, of zaaien wij de gedachte dat innerlijke schoonheid het kostbaarste is om te hebben en te verkrijgen? Ter verduidelijking, ik heb het niet over slordig en onverzorgd zijn. God is een God van orde en reinheid, maar Hij is geen God van linten, strikken, ruches, kant en dure, aantrekkelijke kleding. Onthoud dat de meeste mensen die nieuwe kledingmode creëren, zich richten op het ontwerpen van kleding zodat die aantrekkelijk en aanlokkelijk is voor het oog. Dat is wat mensen doet kopen.

Nogmaals, wanneer mensen ons bekijken, vereren zij ons vleeslijke lichaam of prijzen zij God voor het werk dat Hij in ons leven doet? Ook met betrekking tot dwaasheid en losbandigheid, als wij gegrond zijn in het Woord van God, zullen we geen tijd hebben voor ijdele babbels en genotszoekende ledigheid. Laten we druk bezig zijn het werk van onze Heere te doen, zoals onze naaste helpen die een extra hand kan gebruiken, of ons getuigenis delen met mensen die we ontmoeten.

En vreest niet degenen, die het lichaam doden, maar de ziel niet kunnen doden; maar vrees veeleer Hem, die zowel ziel als lichaam verderven kan in de hel – Mattheüs 10:28. Terwijl wij in deze laatste tijden leven, is de boodschap die overal om ons heen is dat zolang je in een God gelooft, het wel goed komt. Dat is een valse boodschap. Jezus zegt dat er slechts één weg is. Jezus zei tegen hem: Ik ben de weg, en de waarheid, en het leven; niemand komt tot de Vader dan door Mij. Indien gij Mij gekend hadt, zout gij ook Mijn Vader gekend hebben; en van nu aan kent gij Hem en hebt Hem gezien – Johannes 14:6-7. Prijs de Heere dat God ons een voorbeeld gegeven heeft om na te volgen.

Greetings of love in Jesus’ name! We have a great God who is worthy of all our praise, all our love, and our whole life!

We live in a time where there are many distractions. The prince of this world is truly out to destroy people’s lives at whatever cost. We have amusement parks, video arcades, theaters, internet, Facebook, fashion malls, and whatever else you can think of—it’s out there. But God would have our hearts stirred to not be entangled with these distractions, but rather to work for Him and His Kingdom. If we are entangled with the affairs of this life, we will have no time left for our Lord. We cannot serve two masters. There seem to be some things trying to steal the time of our dear sisters (young and old alike). Let us be aware of these things so that we can be free from them and then be free to serve the Lord with our whole hearts.

The one thing we should be aware of is called adornment and the other is foolishness or looseness. To me it is so amazing how God works. He tells us in His Word what not to adorn ourselves with, but He also tells us what to adorn ourselves with. He tells us what fruit should be coming from our lives, and what fruit should not be coming from our lives. For every evil way that there is, God also shows us the right way. I know many of us would not go to fashion malls to buy our clothes, but I fear that many of us are still looking for clothes that accent the body rather than glorify our Lord. Jesus said: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God –Matthew 5:8.

Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel; But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price. For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement –1 Peter 3:3-6.

Adorn: to deck or beautify; set off; to embellish by anything external or adventitious; to display the beauty or excellence of.

Remember, God wants us to adorn ourselves with things that will bring glory to Him. Depending on the type of clothing that I choose to wear, the focus of others is drawn to my clothing first, instead of my countenance. When this happens then I am getting all the glory because the focus is on my apparel. But if somebody sees me and they can see the clear countenance on my face and they can tell that I’ve been with Jesus, then they will give God all the glory that He deserves, and we will be displaying the beauty or excellence of God’s spirit in our lives.

Now let’s take a look at some more of the words found in our Scripture text and consider their meaning:

Plaiting: folding, doubling, braiding.

Apparel: clothing; external habiliments or decorations.

Ornament: That which embellishes; or something which, added to another thing, renders it most beautiful to the eye.

How beautiful it is to our Lord when we become born again, have a broken spirit, and become meek and quiet. Can people see the fruits of God’s spirit in our lives—as ornaments? Truly that is an ornament of great price. Remember we can add external ornaments to our lives that bring sadness to our Father. Let us not make Him ashamed to call us His sons and daughters.

Meek: mild of temper; soft; gentle; not easily provoked or irritated; yielding, given to forbearance under injuries.

Are we irritated if somebody has something to share with us that will help us in our walk with the Lord? Remember our Lord wants the fruit of meekness adorning our converted lives.

Quiet: still; being in a state of rest; not moving; peaceable; not turbulent; not giving offence; not exciting controversy, disorder, or trouble; mild; meek; contented.

With every new style that comes in among us are we quick to change for no reason other than adding something to our bodies that only brings glory to us? Are we content with the biblical standard of God for our lives? Are we firm and grounded in what we believe? Do we know why we believe in what we believe?

Subjection: the act of subduing; the act of vanquishing and bringing under the dominion of another.

Are we under the dominion of our Lord in every aspect of our lives?

Afraid: impressed with fear or apprehension.

Amazement: astonishment; confusion or perplexity from a sudden impression of fear, surprise, or wonder.

We are daughters of Sarah as long as we do well, and are not impressed with fear or any confusion or perplexity. God is not the author of confusion—The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul… –Psalm 19:7. Remember: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom [not confusion]… –Proverbs 9:10.

Entangleth: to twist or interweave in such a manner as not to be easily separated; to perplex or distract, as with cares.

Are we allowing our lives to be interwoven with the fashions and foolishness of this world?

No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier. But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness. Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart –2 Timothy 2:4-22.

Shun: to avoid; to keep clear of; not to fall on or come in contact with; not to mix or associate with.

Are we shunning the practices of this world? More specifically, are we shunning loose and empty talk?

Profane: irreverent to anything sacred; polluted; not pure.

Vain: empty; worthless; having no substance, value, or importance.

What we fill ourselves with will come out. If we are filling ourselves with God’s holy Word, then that will be flowing out of our lives. However, if we are filling ourselves with vain things then that shall come out as well.

Babblings: foolish talk.

Is our talk centered on the Bible, or is it centered on the new things that we have bought such as a new garment or a vehicle, or maybe it’s on all the people we have met on Facebook?

Flee: to run with rapidity, as from danger; to hasten from danger; or expected evil.

If we are with a group of people whose talk is foolish, do we stay for fear of losing friends or do we walk (or run) away from the expected or dangerous evil? The more we interweave our lives with the ways of the world, the harder it is to untangle ourselves.

Lusts: longing desire; eagerness to possess or enjoy; carnal appetite; unlawful desire of carnal pleasure.

God will give us the true desires of our heart. We may say that we desire pure things, but if our heart is yearning for unlawful things, we shall yield to those things. Our lives consist not only in what we say, but more importantly what we live. Also, take courage, the inward desires of our heart can be forever changed through the spiritual operation or “new birth”.

Righteousness: the active and passive obedience of Christ, by which the law of God is fulfilled.

If we are to follow righteousness, then that means we should follow the active and passive obedience that Christ shows us by his example.

Faith: the object of belief; a doctrine or system of doctrines believed.

What is the reality of our faith? Do we really believe God and what He tells us through His written Word? It was because Abraham believed God that he was able to “offer up” his only son Isaac through whom Abraham’s descendants would be counted. –see Hebrews 11:17 and Genesis 22:13. If God tells us in His Word to shun ungodliness because it will lead to more ungodliness, then we need to believe God and flee those things, and we must not allow ourselves to think that just a little bit of fun will not matter.

Charity: love; benevolence; goodwill; that disposition of the heart which inclines men to think favorably of their fellow men, and to do them good; it includes supreme love to God our Maker and universal good will to men.

Do we have the Love of God dwelling within and flowing out of our lives like a spring of running water?

Peace: heavenly rest; harmony; freedom from disturbance or agitation.

We are to follow the example of our dear Savior Jesus Christ whose whole life was in perfect harmony with God the Father. Christ was not disturbed or disrupted by the ways of this world, but He was at rest doing His Father’s will. Are we?

Pure: clear; free from moral defilement; without spot; holy; incorrupt.

We are to follow or have these fruits adorned in our lives and also practicing these with those who are practicing the same things in their own lives. A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array; But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works –1 Timothy 2:9-10.

Shamefacedness: bashfulness; excess of modesty.

We should be adorned with shamefacedness and not giddiness or sensuality.

Sobriety: habitual soberness; seriousness; gravity without sadness or melancholy.

Even if we are sober we don’t need to be sad but we can have the joy of the Lord adorning our lives. There should be a light in our eyes because Jesus is the light of our lives. Truly if God’s spirit is dwelling within us we have so much to be thankful for. It should be evident in every aspect of our lives.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men, Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world –Titus 2:11-12.

I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels –Isaiah 61:10.

The ornaments of modesty, shamefacedness, sobriety, faith, charity, peace, righteousness, meekness, and quietness are truly jewels of great price. These jewels are so valuable that it is worth surrendering our whole lives to the God of Heaven, our Maker, and our Redeemer, so that we may have them adorning our lives. But likewise, if we are surrendered to the god of this world we will have the ornaments of pride, envy, hate, jealousy, and so forth. Which ones are the more beautiful?

And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband. And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God. –Revelation 21:2-3.

Are we preparing to meet Jesus? Is God dwelling in us? Is He our God and are we His people?

Remember time is swiftly passing by. We can be here today and gone tomorrow. Do we want to be with Jesus throughout all eternity, or do we want to be with the devil and his angels? The choices we make for our lives today will affect where we spend eternity.

Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap –Galatians 6:7. Don’t be misled. That verse is also for the believer, not just for the unconverted. Each one of us can ask ourselves what we are sowing. Concerning adornment, are we sowing the thought that outward beauty is very important or are we sowing the thought that inward beauty is the most precious thing to have and obtain? For clarification, I am not talking about being dirty and unkempt. God is a God of order and cleanliness, but He is not a God of ribbons, bows, frills, lace, and expensive, attractive clothing. Remember that most people who create new clothing fashions focus on designing garments so that they will be appealing and attractive to the eye. That is what makes people buy them.

Again, when people look at us do they glorify our fleshly body or are they praising God for the work that He is doing in our lives? Also, concerning foolishness and looseness, if we are grounded in the word of God, we will not have time for vain babblings and pleasure-seeking idleness. Let us be busy doing the work of our Lord, such as helping our neighbor who could use an extra hand, or sharing our testimony with people that we meet.

And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell –Matthew 10:28. As we live in these last times, the message that is all around us is that as long as you believe in a God, you will be okay. That is a false message. Jesus tells us there is only one way. Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him –John 14:6-7. Praise the Lord that God has given us an example to follow.

ברכות של אהבה בשם ישוע! יש לנו אל גדול הראוי לכל שבחינו, לכל אהבתנו ולכל חיינו!

אנו חיים בתקופה שבה יש הרבה הסחות דעת. נסיך העולם הזה באמת שואף להשמיד את חיי האנשים בכל מחיר. יש לנו פארקי שעשועים, ארקיידים של משחקי וידאו, תיאטראות, אינטרנט, פייסבוק, מרכזי קניות אופנתיים, וכל מה שתוכל לחשוב עליו—זה שם בחוץ. אך אלוהים רוצה שבלבנו ייגרש התשוקה לא להסתבך עם הסחות אלה, אלא לעבוד בעד־וּבשׁלטון שלו. אם נתעסק בענייני החיים האלה, לא יישאר לנו זמן לאדוננו. אי אפשר לשרת שני אדונים. נדמה שיש דברים שמנסים לגזול את זמן אחיותינו היקרתיות (צעירות וזקנות כאחד). הבה נהיה ערים לדברים אלה כדי שנוכל להשתחרר מהם ואז לשרת את האדון בכל לבבנו.

הדבר האחד שיש להכיר בו נקרא קישוט, והדבר האחר הוא טיפשות או רַשׁוּת. עבורי זה כה מדהים איך אלוהים פועל. הוא אומר לנו במילותיו מה לא לקשט את עצמנו בו, אבל גם אומר לנו במה לקשט את עצמנו. הוא אומר לנו איזה פרי צריך לבוא מהחיים שלנו, ואיזה פרי לא צריך לבוא מהם. עבור כל דרכי רוע שיש שם, אלוהים מראה לנו גם את הדרך הנכונה. אני יודעת שרבים מאתנו לא ילכו לקניוני האופנה לקנות את בגדינו, אך אני חוששת שרבים מאתנו עדיין מחפשים בגדים המדגישים את הגוף במקום להלל את אדוננו. ישוע אמר: אַשְׁרֵי בַּר־לֵבָב כִּי הֵם יִרְאוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהִים – Matthew 5:8.

וּמִקְשְׁטָהּ אַל־תְּהִי קישוט־מַחֲמַדִּים חיצוניים של בְּעִישַׁת הַשֵּׂעָר וּשְׁאַת־תְּכֵלֶת וּשְׁלִישֵׁי לְבוּשׁ; כִּי יִהְיֶה הֲאָדָם הַמְּסוּתָר בַּלֵּב, בַּנֶּשֶׁךְ הַבְּלִי־הִתְפָּרֵק, תִּפְאֶרֶת רוּחַ שְׁאֵנִית וּשְׁקֵטָה, אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵינֵי הָאֱלֹהִים יְקָרָה מְאֹד. כִּכְךָ בְּיׇמֵי קֶדֶם נָעוּ גַם־נָשִׁים קְדוֹשׁוֹת, הַמַּשְׁתַּחֲוֹת לְאֱלֹהִים, וְהִתְיַחֲסוּ לְבַעֲלֵיהֶן: כְּשָׁרָה שָׁמְעָה לְאַבְרָהָם וְקָרְאָה לוֹ אֲדוֹנִי: בְּנֹתֵיכֶם אַתֶּם, כִּי תַּעַשׂוּ־טוֹב וְלֹא־תִּפְחוּ מִפֶּתַע – 1 Peter 3:3-6.

לקשט: לעטר או להכשיר ליופי; להבליט; לקשט בדבר חיצוני או תוספתי; להציג את היופי או המצוינות של דבר מה.

זכרו, אלוהים רוצה שנקשט את עצמנו בדברים שיביאו לו תהילה. בהתאם לסוג הבגדים שאבחר ללבוש, המוקד של אחרים נמשך אל בגדיי קודם כל, במקום אל פניי. כאשר זה קורה אני מקבלת את כל התהילה כי המוקד הוא על בגדיי. אך אם מישהו רואה אותי ורואים את מראֵי הפנים הברור ויכולים לזהות שעברתי עם ישוע, הם יתנו לאלוהים את כל התהילה הראויה לו, ונציג את היופי או המצוינות של רוח האלוהים בחיינו.

כעת בואו נבחן עוד ממילות הטקסט המקראי ונשקול את משמעותן:

לְקָלֵעַ: לקפל, להכפיל, לקלוע.

לְבוּשׁ: בגדים; חגורה חיצונית או קישוטים חיצוניים.

עוֹטֶרֶת: מה שמקשט; או משהו שמתווסף לדבר אחר והופך אותו ליפה יותר בעיני העין.

כמה יפה זה בעיני אדוננו כשאנו נאספים מחדש מלידה רוחנית, יש לנו רוח שבורה, והופכים לענווים ושקטים. האם אנשים יכולים לראות את פירות רוח הקדוש בחיינו—כעיטורים? באמת שזה עֹטֶרֶת יקרה מאד. זכרו שאנו יכולים להוסיף על חיינו עיטורים חיצוניים שיביאו עצב לאבינו. אל נבישו אותו בקריאתנו לבנו בנים ובנותיו.

ענוּת: שְׁלֵמוּת מזג; עדינות; רוך; לא ניתנת בקלות להכעיס או להרגיז; פְּנִיָּה, מתאיירת לסבול תחת פגיעות.

האם אנו נִרְגָּזִים אם מישהו חולק עמנו משהו שיעזור לנו בהלכתנו עם האדון? זכרו שהאדון רוצה את פרי הענווה כקִישוט לחיינו המומרים.

שֶׁקֶט: דומם; להיות במצב מנוחה; לא זז; שיְרָאִי; לא סועֵר; שלא יֵסֵב־עוֹלה; שלא מעורר מחלוקת, הפרעה או צרות; עדין; צנוע; מרוצה.

עם כל סגנון חדש שמופיע בקרבנו האם אנחנו ממהרים להשתנות מסיבה שאין מאחורי אלא הוספת משהו על גופנו שמכביר כבוד לעצמנו? האם אנו מרוצים מהסטנדרט המקראי שאלוהים קבע לחיינו? האם אנו מוחזקים ועם יסוד באמונתו של מה שאנו מאמינים? האם אנו יודעים מדוע אנו מאמינים במה שאנו מאמינים?

צִיוּת: מעשה הכבשה; מעשה הניצחון והבאת תחת שלטון אחר.

האם אנו תחת שלטון אדוננו בכל היבט מחיינו?

מפוחד: מרוקן פחד או חשש.

תּוּמָה: תדהמה; בלבול או שלמות מהתלחששות פתאומית של פחד, הפתעה או תמיהה.

אנו בנות שרה כל עוד נעשה טוב, ואיננו נִרְתָּעִים מפחד או מכל תמהה או מבולבלות. אלוהים אינו עושה בלבול—תּוֹרַת יְהוָה תָּמָה מְשַׁבֶּת־נָפֶשׁ… – Psalm 19:7. זכרו: יִרְאַת יְהוָה רֵאשִׁית דַּעַת [לא בלבול] … – Proverbs 9:10.

להִשְׁתַּלֵּב: לסרוג או לקשר באופן שלא ניתנת פירוקה בקלות; לְסַבֵּךְ או להסיח, כמו עם דאגות.

האם אנו מרשותים לחיינו להיות שזורים עם האופנות והשטויות של העולם הזה?

אִישׁ הַמִּלְחָמָה לֹא מִתְעַרְבֵּב בְּעִנְיְנֵי הַחַיִּים הָאֵלֶּה, לְמַעַן יַעֲשֶׁה אֶת־אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר־בוֹ לִהְיוֹת חַיָּל. וּמְהֵרֲצוּ פִּלֵּלוֹת בּוּזִים וְרֵיקִים: כִּי יִרְבּוּ לְעֲו‍ָּלָה גְּדוֹלָה. וּבְרַחוֹק תַּחְמֹדְנוּת נְעוּרִים: וּבַעֲקֵב שָׁמְעוּ צֶדֶק, אֱמוּנָה, אָהֲבָה, שָׁלוֹם, עִם־קֹרְאֵי יְהוָה מִלֵּב טָהוֹר – 2 Timothy 2:4-22.

הָמִּר: להמנע; לשמור מרחק; לא ליפול על או לבוא במגע עם; לא לערבב או להסתבך עם.

האם אנו נמנעים ממנהגי העולם הזה? באופן ספציפי יותר, האם אנו נמנעים מדיבורים ריקים ומשוחררים?

חֲלָל: חוסר יראת כבוד לכל דבר קדוש; טמא; לא טהור.

רִיק: ריקנות; חסר ערך; שאין בו מהות, ערך או חשיבות.

מה שאנו ממלאים את עצמנו בו יצא החוצה. אם אנו ממלאים את עצמנו במילת אלוהים הקדושה, היא תזרום מתוך חיינו. אולם אם אנו ממלאים עצמנו בדברים ריקניים, גם הם יצאו החוצה.

לְשׁוֹן־רֵיק: דִּבּוּרִים טפשיים.

האם שיחתנו מתמקדת בתנ"ך, או מתמקדת בדברים החדשים שקנינו כמו בגד חדש או רכב, או אולי בכל האנשים שפגשנו בפייסבוק?

לְבָרֵחַ: לרוץ במהירות, כאילו מפני סכנה; למהר מפני סכנה או רע צפוי.

אם אנו עם קבוצת אנשים ששיחתם טיפשית, האם נישאר מפחד לאבד חברים או נלך (או נברח) מן הרע הצפוי? ככל שנשזור את חיינו יותר בדרכי העולם, כך קשה יותר להשתחרר.

תַּאֲווָה: תאווה עזה; רצון עז להחזיק או ליהנות; תיאבון בָּשָׂרִי; רצון בלתי־חוקי להנאה בשרית.

אלוהים יתן לנו את התשוקות האמיתיות של לבנו. נוכל לומר שאנו חפצים בדברים טהורים, אך אם לבנו משתוקק לדברים בלתי־חוקיים, ניכנע לאותם דברים. חיינו אינם מורכבים רק ממה שאנו אומרים, אלא חשוב יותר ממה שאנו חיים. גם תקוּינוּ, הרצונות הפנימיים של לבנו יכולים להשתנות לנצח דרך הפעולה הרוחנית של "הלידה מחדש".

צֶדֶק: הישר והצייתנות הפעילה והסבילה של המשיח, שעל־ידי הם מקיימים את תורת אלוהים.

אם עלינו ללכת בעקבות הצדק, פירושו שעלינו ללכת בעקבות הציות הפעיל והסביל שהמשיח מראה לנו בדוגמתו.

אֱמוּנָה: עצם האמונה; דוקטרינה או מערכת דוקטרינות שהאדם מאמין בהן.

מהי מציאות אמונתנו? האם אנו באמת מאמינים באלוהים ובמה שהוא אומר לנו באמצעות דברו הכתוב? כי אברהם האמין לאלוהים והוא היה מסוגל "להעלות" את בנו היחיד יצחק שבאמצעותו נספרו צאצאי אברהם. –ראה Hebrews 11:17 ו- Genesis 22:13. אם אלוהים אומר לנו במקרא שיש להמנע מאי־הלכות כי הדבר יוליך לעוד אי־הלכות, עלינו להאמין לאלוהים ולברוח מאותם דברים, ולא לאפשר לעצמנו לחשוב שרק קצת הנאה לא ייחשב.

חֶסֶד: אהבה; נדיבות; רצון טוב; הנטייה של הלב להחשיב את הזולת בחן ולעשות לו טוב; כוללת אהבה עליונה לאלוהים בוראנו ורצון טוב כלפי כל בני האדם.

האם אהבת אלוהים שורה בתוכנו וזורמת מחיינו כמבצע של מי מעיין זורם?

שָׁלוֹם: מנוחה שמימית; הרמוניה; חופש מהפרעה או התנודדות.

עלינו ללכת בעקבות דוגמת מושיענו היקר ישוע המשיח שחי כולו בהרמוניה מושלמת עם האב. המשיח לא הופרע או הוטרד מדרכי העולם הזה, אלא היה במנוחה בעשיית רצון אביו. האם אנו כך?

טָהוֹר: נקי; חופשי מטומאה מוסרית; ללא כתם; קדוש; בלתי־נבלע.

עלינו להיעטר או שיהיו פרי אלה בחיינו וגם לתרגלם עם אלה המתרגלים את אותם הדברים בחייהם. שמר קטן משפיע על כל הבצק.

בְּאוֹפֶן דָּמֵה גַּם־נָשִׁים יִעַטְרוּ בַּלְּבוּשׁ צָנוּעַ, בְּחֶשְׁפּוּת וּבְשִׁקְרוּת; לֹא בְּשַׁעַר מְעֻטָּר, וְלֹא בְּזָהָב, וְלֹא בְּפְנִנִּים, וְלֹא בְּהִזְרְקוּת יְקָרָה; כִּי אִם־אֵלֶּה הֵם הַדְּבָרִים הַמְּשֻׁוָּיִים לְנָשִׁים הַמַּגִּידוֹת צְדָקָה, עַל־יְדֵי מַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים – 1 Timothy 2:9-10.

חֶסְרוֹן בְּבַשָּׁה: ביישנות; עודף צניעות.

עלינו להתעטר בצניעות ולא בשעטנות או תחושת חושניות.

שִׁכּוּרִיוּת מְשׁוּנֶה: פכחות מתמשכת; רצינות; כובד ראש ללא עצב או מלנכוליה.

אפילו אם אנו פכוחים אין צורך להיות עצובים אך נוכל לשאת את שמחת האדון כעיטור לחיינו. צריכה להיות אש בעינינו כי ישוע הוא אור חיינו. אם רוח האלוהים שורה בנו יש לנו כל כך הרבה להודות עליו. זה צריך להיות ברור בכל היבט של חיינו.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

כִּי חֵן־אֱלֹהִים שֶׁמֵּבִיא הַיְשׁוּעָה הִתְגַּלָּה לְקָהַל־הָאָדָם, מְלַמֶּדֶת אוֹתָנוּ לְהִכָּחֵשׁ לְאֵימוּת וְלִתְאווֹת הָעוֹלָם, לְּחַיוֹת בְּפֶכַח, בְּצֶדֶק וּבְיְרוּשָׁת אֱלֹהִים בַּעֲתָה הִוא – Titus 2:11-12.

אֲנִי אֶשְׂמַח בַּיהוָה מְאֹד; תִּהְיֶה נַפְשִׁי שְׂמֵחָה בֵּאלֹהַי; כִּי־לָבַשׁ אֹתִי בִּגְדֵי הַיְשׁוּעָה, וְכִסָּנִי בִּשְׂמַלְתַּ צֶדֶק; כְּאִישׁ חָתָן הַמְעַטֵּר עַצְמוֹ בְּתְפִאֶרֶת, וּכְכַלָּה מְקַשֶּׁטֶת עַצְמָהּ בְּתְכֵלֶתָהּ – Isaiah 61:10.

עיטורי צניעות, ביישנות, פכחות, אמונה, אהבה, שלום, צדק, ענוה ושקט הם באמת תכשיטים יקרי ערך. תכשיטים אלה כה יקרים שכדאי להקדיש את כל חיינו לאלוהי השמים, בוראנו וגואלנו, כדי שיהיו מעטרים את חיינו. אך באותו אופן, אם אנו נשלטים על־ידי אלוהי העולם הזה נקבל את העיטורים של גאווה, קנאה, שנאה, קנאה וכדומה. אילו מהם יפים יותר?

וָאֶרְאֶה אֲנִי יוֹחָנָן אֶת־הָעִיר הַקְּדוֹשָׁה, יְרוּשָׁלַיִם הָחָדָשָׁה — יוֹרֶדֶת מֵאֵת הָאֱלֹהִים מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם, מוּכָנָה כְּכַלָּה מְחֻנָּקֶת לְאִישָׁהּ. וָאֶשְׁמַע קוֹל גָּדוֹל מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם אָמֵר הִנֵּה אֹהֶל־אֱלֹהִים עִם־הָאָדָם וְיֵשְׁבֶה בָּהֶם, וְהִנֵּה עַמּוֹ וְהָאֱלֹהִים יִהְיוּ עִמָּם – Revelation 21:2-3.

האם אנו מתכוננות להיפגש עם ישוע? האם אלוהים שורה בתוכנו? האם הוא אלוהינו ואנו עמו עמו?

זכרו הזמן חולף במהירות. אנו עלולים להיות כאן היום ולנעלם מחר. האם נרצה להיות עם ישוע לנצח, או עם השטן ומלאכיו? הבחירות שנעשה היום ישפיעו על מקום שהראנו לנצחיות.

אַל־תְּשָׁגוּ, אֵין אֱלֹהִים מְתַלֵּחַ: כִּי מַה שׇׁזֹרֵעַ אָדָם,־זֶה יִקְצֹר גַּם־הוּא – Galatians 6:7. אל תתנו להטעות. הפסוק הזה מיועד גם למאמין, לא רק ללא־נוצרי. כל אחד מאתנו יכול לשאול את עצמו מה אנו זורעים. באשר לקישוט, האם אנו זורעים את המחשבה שיופי חיצוני הוא חשוב מאד או שאנו זורעים את המחשבה שיופי פנימי הוא הדבר היקר ביותר שיש להשיג? להבהרה, אינני מדברת על לכלוך והזנחה. אלוהים הוא אל סדר ונקיון, אך הוא אינו אל סרטים, קישוטים, תחרה ובגדים יקרים ומפתים. זכרו שרוב היוצרים של אופנות חדשות מתמקדים בעיצוב בגדים שיהיו מושכים ויפה לעין. זו הסיבה שאנשים קונים אותם.

שוב, כאשר אנשים מסתכלים עלינו האם הם מהללים את גופנו הבשׂרי או מהללים את אלוהים על העבודה שהוא עושה בחיינו? גם, לגבי טיפשות ורשות, אם אנו עומדות על יסוד דבר אלוהים, לא יהיה לנו זמן לדיבורים ריקים ולבטלנות מבקשת הנאה. הבה נהיה עסוקות בעבודת אדוננו, כגון לעזור לשכן שצריך יד נוספת, או לשתף את עדותנו עם האנשים שפוגשים אותנו.

וְאַל־תִּירָאוּ מֵהָרֹצְחִים אֶת־הַבָּשָׂר, אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָכוֹלִים לְהָרֹג אֶת־הַנֶּפֶשׁ; וַאֲבָל יִרְאֵהוּ יוֹתֵר אֵת הַמּוּכַל לְאַבְדֵהוּ גַּם־נֶפֶשׁ וְגַם־בָּשָׂר בַּשְּׁאוֹל – Matthew 10:28. כשהננו לחיות בַּיָּמִים האלו, המסר שסובב אותנו הוא שכָּכָה שׁאַתָּה מַאֲמִין בְּאלוהים, תִּהְיֶה בְּסֵדֶר. זו הודעה שגויה. ישוע אומר שיש רק דרך אחת. יֵשׁוּעַ אָמַר לוֹ, אֲנִי הָדֶּרֶךְ וְהָאֱמֶת וְהַחַיִּים; אֵין־אִישׁ בָּא אֶל־הָאָב כִּי אִם־עַל־יָדִי. לוּ הֲיִדַעְתֶּם אוֹתִי לָכֵן הֲיִדַעְתֶּם אֶת־הָאָב גַּם־הוּא: וּמֵעַתָּה תֵּדְעוּ אוֹתִי וְרָאִיתֶם אוֹתוֹ – John 14:6-7. הודו לאדון שאלוהים נתן לנו דוגמה להליכה אחריה.

On November 27, 1560, Sotegen Van Den Houte of Ghent, Holland was martyred for her faith in the Lord, Jesus Christ. Prior to her passing, her husband had also been martyred for his faith. During the time of her imprisonment, she wrote several lengthy letters to her three youth-aged children. The following are abridged excerpts of these letters which can be found in full text on pages 646-651 in the Martyr’s Mirror.

Grace, peace, and mercy from God, the Father, and the Lord, Jesus Christ, to my dear children, David, Betgen, and Tanneken. This affectionate greeting, written by your mother in bonds, is a memorial of the truth to you. I hope to testify to this Truth by my words, my life, and my death, with the help of the Most High. May the wisdom of the Holy Ghost instruct and strengthen you, that you may be brought up in the ways of the Lord. Since it pleases the Lord to take me out of this world, I will leave you this memorial of my faith in the only true God, not of silver or gold for such jewels are perishable.

Receive admonition. First, I admonish you, my most beloved children, always allow yourselves to be instructed by those who fear the Lord. As long as you obey good admonition and instruction, God will be your Father and not leave you as orphans. For David says: What man is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose –Psalm 25:12. Children, grieve not when you are corrected and do not speak in anger to those who correct you. A wise son heareth his father’s instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke –Proverbs 13:1.

Guard your tongue. My dear children, guard your tongue, that it speak no evil. Do not practice deceit or backbiting with your lips. Paul teaches us to live peaceably with all men if it be possible. –see 1 Peter 3:10 and Romans 12:18. If you are crossly spoken to, learn to answer kindly, and you will be loved by all men. Humility and meekness are acceptable to both God and man.

Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight –Proverbs 12:22. I admonish you to beware of lying, since liars have no part in the kingdom of God. –see Revelation 21:8.

Be diligent in work and give alms. Always be diligent to do your work, wherever you be; for Paul says …that if any would not work, neither should he eat –2 Thessalonians 3:10. It is also written, be diligent to labor, that you …may have to give to him that needeth –Ephesians 4:28.

Do not turn your face away from the poor. Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard –Proverbs 21:13. Therefore, be diligent in prayer, and love the poor; for Christ also was poor for our sakes—For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich –2 Corinthians 8:9. Be therefore also merciful, even as your heavenly Father is merciful; for such shall be blessed, and shall obtain mercy. –see Matthew 5:7.

Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith –Proverbs 15:16. And, Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife –Proverbs 17:1. Choose to earn your bread by the labor of your hands, and to eat your bread with peace. Seek not to be a merchant, nor be anxious for great gain.

Be meek, merciful, and pure in heart. Learn to be meek and lowly in heart for such are blessed and shall inherit the earth. Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful. Luke 6:36. And, Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth –Matthew 5:5. Finally, Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God –Matthew 5:8. Hence, my dear children, let no impure thoughts remain in your hearts. Engage yourselves with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs and evil thoughts will have no room. –see Ephesians 5:19.

Neither let filthiness proceed out of your mouth. You will have to give an account of all filthiness. –see Matthew 12:36-37. Always esteem yourselves as the least and be not wise in your own conceit. Allow yourselves to be instructed by your elders and always be silent when others speak. Humble yourselves, for …whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted –Matthew 23:12. For Christ who is the greatest made Himself the least for an example unto us. –see John 13:13-15.

Avoid a luxurious life. My children, do not desire the luxuries of fine food or wine. He that desires costly feasts will not become rich. Be content with the labor of your hands. Do not be a burden to anyone as long as you can obtain the things needful—…It is more blessed to give than to receive –Acts 20:35. Paul says: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content –1 Timothy 6:8.

Be sober and thankful as you have heard me read of Daniel, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. They were selected by the king of Babylon to be nourished with the same wine and meat which the king drank and ate at his table. But they chose to have pulse [vegetables] and water. They wanted to observe the law and commandments of their fathers with sobriety and thankfulness in the fear of God. In the end, they were fairer and fatter than those who ate of the king’s dainties, see Daniel chapter 1. Thus, faithfully they walked in the ways of the Lord. They made themselves acceptable to God in prayer and supplication, therefore, he did great things through them. He delivered them from the den of lions and out of the fiery furnace.

When Joseph was sold into Egypt, he desired no worldly dainties. When the Egyptian woman sought to seduce him, he feared God, and God preserved him. He pleased God in sobriety and prayer and God appointed him ruler over Egypt. –see Genesis chapters 37, 39, and 41. Take an example from this in your youth and you will please God. He will keep you from all seduction.

Oh, my lambs, you are still in your youth, yet you have a part in your Father’s kingdom. See that you keep it well and not as Esau who gave his inheritance or birthright for a mess of pottage, disregarding his father’s blessing. –see Genesis 25:30-34. But Jacob chose the better part, walking in the ways of the Lord with all righteousness.

Shun worldly living. Do not delight in the evils of the world such as lying, cheating, gambling, banqueting, playing, swearing, cursing, backbiting, hatred, and dancing, nor envy, drunkenness, excess, idolatry, covetousness, lasciviousness, vanity, filthy conversation. Though the world does not consider these things to be sin but rather calls them amusements, nevertheless, they are abominations in the eyes of the Lord. –see 1 Peter 4:3-4. If you take pleasure in these things, you sell your birthright (or the spiritual inheritance) from your Father, for a mess of pottage—namely, for a few temporal pleasures, which lead you to damnation.

Choose to suffer affliction with the children of God. From the time of Abel until now many have been afflicted and have suffered. They were rejected, despised, persecuted, and killed because they would not follow the wicked world and her false prophets.

My children, choose …rather to suffer affliction with the people of God [that you may be rewarded with them], than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season –Hebrews 11:25. Unto such belong all the beautiful promises of God. It is written: …ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy –John 16:20. And, Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life –Revelation 2:10. Finally, These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world –John 16:33.

Instructions to my son, David. David, my dear son, I commend you to the Lord. You are the oldest; learn wisdom, so that you may be a good example to your sisters. Beware of bad company and of playing in the street with bad boys. Diligently learn to read and write so that you may get understanding.

Love one another without contention or quarreling. Be kind to your sisters. Bear them up as the stronger and out of love help all you can. Assist them out of brotherly love.

Learn to obey your elders in that which is good. Be industrious so that people may love you. Exhort one another to good works, modesty, honorableness, and quietness. Always care for one another for the time has come that …iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold –Matthew 24:12.

Beware of deception. Remember, Jesus said …that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect –Matthew 24:24. Learn to diligently search the Scriptures so that you may not be deceived. Do not believe gossip but examine the matter.

Make no commotion when you are slandered but bear it for Christ’s sake. Love your enemies and pray for those who speak evil of you and afflict you. Suffer affliction rather than afflicting others. Suffer reproach rather than reproaching others. Be slandered rather than slandering others.

You must constantly see that you do not seek solely your own profit, but always care for those with whom you have dealings, whether they be young or old.

Instructions to my daughters Betgen and Tanneken, my beloved lambs, I admonish you in all these same things, that you obey the commandments of the Lord. Also, obey your elders and all who instruct you in virtue.

Be diligent to do your work, and you will be loved wherever you live. Don’t be quarrelsome, talkative, light-minded, proud, or surly of speech. Be kind, honorable, and quiet, as behooves young girls.

Pray the Lord for wisdom, and it shall be given you. Diligently learn to read and write, and take delight therein, and you will become wise. Take pleasure and sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Learn to please the Lord from your youth, as did the holy women and virgins of old. Esther also was a virgin who feared God; she was adorned with humility, was gracious, honorable, kind, and humble of heart; hence she pleased King Ahasuerus above all the other virgins. –see Esther 2:17. But even in her high estate she was not proud. Though she shone in royal apparel, she humbled her heart with fasting and prayer to the Lord, for her brethren, that they might be delivered out of the hands of their enemies. She did not esteem herself better than one of the least of her brethren.

When you have attained the years of understanding, see that you adorn yourselves with the works of the Spirit such as goodness, gentleness, meekness, humility, obedience, long suffering, righteousness, modesty, honorableness, purity, peaceableness, steadfastness, mercifulness, wisdom, diligence in good works, faith, hope and love. Love God above all that is in the world and do to your neighbor as you would have men do unto you. –see Galatians 5:22-23 and Titus 2:3-5. Remember that Jesus said: …Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind. This is the first and great commandment. And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets –Matthew 22:37-40.

Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready. And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints –Revelation 19:7-8. My daughters, this is the adornment of the saints; labor for such a wedding garment, so that you may enter into the marriage of the Lamb, where they …the righteous, [shall] shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father… –Matthew 13:43. May the Lord lead you as He led Israel out of Egypt, and bring you to the New Jerusalem, that we may see each other with joy in the day of the resurrection. I commend you to the Lord, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob; may He keep you to the end of your lives.

In conclusion, O my dear children, I have written this in tears, admonishing you out of love. My prayer and solicitude are constantly for your salvation. I hope and pray constantly that He, in His mercy, will preserve you, just as He preserved Joseph, Moses, and Daniel in the midst of wicked men. And He will do this if you give diligence to follow the truth.

This is my last farewell, my dear lambs. always remember each other in love; diligently learn to read and write and obey everyone in that which is good. I bid you adieu, my dear children Betgen, David and Tanneken. Adieu all my dear brethren and sisters, and friends everywhere.

Written by me, Soetgen van den Houte, your mother in bonds; written in haste (while trembling with cold), out of love for you all, amen.

Mnamo Novemba 27, 1560, Sotegen Van Den Houte wa Ghent, Uholanzi aliteswa hadi kufa kwa ajili ya imani yake kwa Bwana, Yesu Kristo. Kabla ya kufa kwake, mumewe pia aliteswa hadi kufa kwa ajili ya imani yake. Wakati wa kifungo chake, aliandika barua nyingi ndefu kwa watoto wake watatu waliokuwa wakiwa vijana. Zifuatazo ni vifupi vya barua hizi ambazo zinaweza kupatikana kwa maandishi kamili katika kurasa 646-651 katika Martyr’s Mirror.

Neema, amani, na rehema kutoka kwa Mungu, Baba, na Bwana, Yesu Kristo, kwa watoto wangu wapendwa, David, Betgen, na Tanneken. Salamu hii ya upendo, iliyoandikwa na mama yenu akiwa amefungwa, ni kumbukumbu ya ukweli kwenu. Ninatumai kuthibitisha Hili Ukweli kwa maneno yangu, maisha yangu, na kifo changu, kwa msaada wa Yeye Aliye Juu. Mama Mwepesi atumee hekima ya Roho Mtakatifu ili kuwapilia na kuwatii nguvu, ili mkomlezwe katika njia za Bwana. Kwa kuwa inafaa kwa Bwana kuniondoa katika ulimwengu huu, nitawaacha kumbukumbu hii ya imani yangu kwa Mungu wa kweli pekee, si ya fedha wala ya dhahabu kwa kuwa vito hivyo hupitwa.

Pokea adhabu. Kwanza, ninawapongeza, watoto wangu wa mpenzi, kila wakati jiwekee kunuliwa na wale wanaomcha Bwana. Muda wote mnatimiza ushauri na mafundisho mema, Mungu atakuwa Baba yenu na wasiwasi kuwatupa mjiota. Kwa kuwa David anasema: Nani yule mtu anayemuogopa BWANA? ndiye atakayemfundisha njia atakayomchagua –Zaburi 25:12. Watoto, msionee huzuni wakati mkaniswa na msiongei kwa ghadhabu wale wanaokurekebisha. Mwana mwenye busara anasikia mafundisho ya baba yake: lakini mpinzani hasikii korekodi –Methali 13:1.

Linda ulimi wenu. Watoto wangu wapendwa, linda ulimi wenu, usiliseme mabaya. Msifanye udanganyifu wala kueneza chuki kwa midomo yenu. Paulo anatufundisha kuishi kwa amani na watu wote iwapo inawezekana. –tazama 1 Petro 3:10 na Warumi 12:18. Ikiwa mtaongewa kwa ukali, jifunze kujibu kwa wema, na mtapendwa na wote. Unyenyekevu na upole vinakubalika kwa Mungu na mwanadamu.

Midomo ya uongo ni chukizo kwa BWANA: lakini wale wanaofanya ukweli ni furaha yake –Methali 12:22. Ninawapa onyo muwe waangalifu dhidi ya uongo, kwa kuwa waongo hawana sehemu katika ufalme wa Mungu. –tazama Ufunuo 21:8.

Kuwa mtii kazini na toa sadaka. Kila wakati fanyeni kazi zenu kwa bidii, mahali popote mlipo; kwa kuwa Paulo anasema …kwa maana ikiwa mtu hataki kufanya kazi, naye asile –2 Wathesalonike 3:10. Pia imeandikwa, jitahidi kufanya kazi, ili …uweze kutoa kwa mwenye hitaji –Waefeso 4:28.

Usigeuze uso wako kwa maskini. Ayaye anayesikiza masikio yake kwa kilio cha maskini, naye atalia, lakini hatasikilizwa –Methali 21:13. Kwa hiyo, kuwa mzito wa sala, na wapende maskini; kwa kuwa Kristo pia alikuwa maskini kwa ajili yetu— Kwa hivyo kuwa wema, kama Baba yenu wa mbinguni ni mwenye rehema; kwa kuwa hao watabarikiwa, na watapata rehema. –tazama Mathayo 5:7.

Bora kidogo na woga wa BWANA kuliko hazina kubwa pamoja na taabu nayo –Methali 15:16. Na, Bora ni ukoma mkavu, na utulivu pamoja nalo, kuliko nyumba iliyojaa dhabihu kwa vita –Methali 17:1. Chagua kupata mkate wako kwa kazi ya mikono yako, na kula mkate wako kwa amani. Usitafute kuwa mfanyabiashara, wala usikate tamaa kwa faida kubwa.

Kuwa mpole, mwenye rehema, na mtakatifu wa moyo. Jifunze kuwa mpole na mwenye unyonge wa moyo kwa kuwa hao watabarikiwa na watarithi nchi. Kwa hiyo kuwa na rehema, kama vile Baba yenu pia ana rehema. Luka 6:36. Na, Herufi ni wale wanyenyekevu: kwa maana nao watarithi nchi –Mathayo 5:5. Mwishowe, Herufi ni watakatifu wa moyo: kwa maana wao wataona Mungu –Mathayo 5:8. Kwa hiyo, watoto wangu wapendwa, msiruhusu mawazo machafu kubaki mioyoni mwenu. Jishughuliseni na zaburi, nyimbo, na nyimbo za kiroho na mawazo mabaya hayatakuwa na nafasi. –tazama Waefeso 5:19.

Msiruhusu uchafu uje kutoka mdomoni mwenu. Mtakuwa na kutoa hesabu ya uchafu wote. –tazama Mathayo 12:36-37. Kila wakati jiheshimieni kama walio wachache na msijione wenye busara kwa kujiona wenyewe. Jiruhusu kufundishwa na wazee wenu na mnyamazishe kila mtu anapoongea. Mwenyenyekevu nafsi zenu, kwa kuwa …ye yeyote atakayejidanganya atadidimika; naye atakayejinyenyekea atapongezeka –Mathayo 23:12. Kwa kuwa Kristo ambaye ni mkubwa alijifanya kuwa mdogo kwa mfano kwetu. –tazama Yohana 13:13-15.

Epuka maisha ya unyenyekevu wa kifahari. Watoto wangu, msitake utamu wa chakula kizuri au mvinyo. Yeye anayetaka meza za kifahari hatakuwa tajiri. Kutimizeni kwa kazi ya mikono yenu. Usiwachangamshi wengine mradi msiwe mzigo kwa mtu yeyote mradi tu mtaweza kupata vitu muhimu—…zuri ni kumpa kuliko kupokea –Matendo 20:35. Paulo anasema: Na tukiwa na chakula na nguo, tutafurahie yale –1 Timotheo 6:8.

Kuwarembesha mtulivu na wa shukrani kama nilivyowasomea kuhusu Danieli, Shadraki, Meshaki, na Abednego. Walichaguliwa na mfalme wa Babeli kulishiwa na divai na chakula ambacho mfalme alikuwa anakinywa na kukila katika meza yake. Lakini walichagua kula maharage [mboga] na maji. Walitaka kutii sheria na amri za babu zao kwa unyenyekevu na shukrani kwa kuogopa Mungu. Mwisho wake, walikuwa wagonjwa na walikuwa warembo zaidi kuliko wale waliokula samaki za kifalme, tazama Danieli sura ya 1. Hivyo, kwa uaminifu walitembea katika njia za Bwana. Walijipendekeza mbele za Mungu kwa sala na maombi, kwa hiyo, Mungu akafanya mambo makubwa kwao. Akawatokezea kutoka limbogani mwa simba na kutoka tanuru ya moto.

Wakati Yusufu aliuziwa kwenda Misri, hakutaka utamu wa dunia. Wakati mke wa Mmisri alipomjaribu kumpendeza, alimuogopa Mungu, na Mungu akamuhifadhi. Alimridhisha Mungu kwa unyenyekevu na sala na Mungu akamteua kuwa mtawala wa Misri. –tazama Mwanzo sura 37, 39, na 41. Chukua mfano kutoka hapa ukiwa mchuzi wa ujana na utampendeza Mungu. Atakuepusha na kila jaribu la uadhalilishaji.

Ewe weredi zangu, bado mko vijana, hata hivyo mna sehemu katika ufalme wa Baba yenu. Angalia mtunze kwa uangalifu na si kama Esau aliyetoa urithi wake au haki ya kuzaliwa kwa kikombe cha supu, akisitilia baraka za baba yake. –tazama Mwanzo 25:30-34. Lakini Yakobo alichagua sehemu bora, akitembea katika njia za Bwana kwa haki zote.

Etuka maisha ya dunia. Msifurahie mabaya ya dunia kama uongo, udanganyifu, kamari, karamu, kucheza, kuapa, kumlaani, kumtukana kwa nyuma, chuki, na kucheza, wala wivu, ulevi, kupitia kiasi, sanamu, tamaa ya mali, ukahaba, kiburi, mazungumzo machafu. Ingawa dunia haizingatii mambo haya kuwa dhambi bali huwaita burudani, hata hivyo, ni aibu machoni pa Bwana. –tazama 1 Petro 4:3-4. Ikiwa mnapata furaha kwa mambo haya, mmeuza haki yenu ya kuzaliwa (au urithi wa kiroho) kutoka kwa Baba yenu, kwa kikombe cha supu—yaani, kwa raha chache za muda, ambazo zinakupeleka katika laana.

Chagua kustahimili dhiki pamoja na watoto wa Mungu. Tangu wakati wa Heveli hadi sasa wengi wameonewa na kustahimili. Walikataliwa, wakazuiwa, wakatia shinikizo, na kuuawa kwa sababu hawakuunga mkono dunia iliyo uovu na wabashiri wake wa uongo.

Watoto wangu, chagua …badala yake kustahimili dhiki pamoja na watu wa Mungu [ili mrudishwe nao], kuliko kufurahia raha za dhambi kwa muda –Waebrania 11:25. Kwa watendewa hao zinamhusu haki zote nzuri za ahadi za Mungu. Imeandikwa: …mtalia na kulilia lakini ulimwengu utafurahia: nanyi mtakuwa na huzuni, lakini huzuni yenu itageuzwa kuwa furaha –Yohana 16:20. Na, Msiogope yale mnatayari kustahimili: tazama, shetani atawatupa baadhi yenu gerezani, ili mjaribiwe; nanyi mtakuwa na mateso kwa siku kumi: uwe mwaminifu hata kifo, nami nitakupa taji la uzima –Ufunuo 2:10. Mwishowe, Mambo haya nimeyazungumzia nanyi, ili ndani yangu mpate amani. Katika ulimwengu mtakuwa na dhiki: lakini simeni moyo; mimi nimevatangulia ulimwenguni –Yohana 16:33.

Maelekezo kwa mwana wangu, David. David, mwana wangu mpendwa, ninakuombea kwa Bwana. Wewe ni mkubwa; jifunze hekima, ili uwe mfano mzuri kwa dada zako. Jiwekee tahadhari dhidi ya marafiki wabaya na kucheza mitaani na wavulana wabaya. Jifunze kwa bidii kusoma na kuandika ili upate ufahamu.

Mpendezane bila mizozo au ugomvi. Mwandikie wema dada zako. Waidini kama wako wenye nguvu na kwa upendo wasaidie kadri utakavyoweza. Wawezeshe kwa upendo wa kaka.

Jifunze kumtii wazee wenu katika yale yaliyofaa. Kuwa mwenye bidii ili watu wakupende. Himizeni miongoni mwa nyenzo za matendo mema, ukomavu, heshima, na utulivu. Kila wakati wataletea kila mmoja kwa sababu wakati umefika kwamba …uovu utakua mwingi, upendo wa wengi utakauka –Mathayo 24:12.

Itaepuka kudanganyikiwa. Kumbuka, Yesu alisema …kwamba, ikiwa inawezekana, watawadanganya hata wale walioteuliwa –Mathayo 24:24. Jifunze kutafuta kwa bidii Maandiko ili msidanganywe. Msiamini uongozi wa maneno bali chunguza jambo kwa undani.

Usizibe kelele wakati unaseswa bali uvumilie kwa ajili ya Kristo. Mpende maadui zenu na waombe wale wanaosema mabaya juu yenu na kuwatesa. Stahimili dhiki badala ya kuwatenda wengine mabaya. Stahimili kudharauliwa badala ya kudharaumu wengine. Ulipuuzwe badala ya kusambaza uongo dhidi ya wengine.

Lazima kila mara uone kwamba hutafuti faida yako pekee, bali daima utazipenda zile unazofanyia biashara, iwe ni vijana au wazee.

Maelekezo kwa ndivyo zangu Betgen na Tanneken, weredi zangu wapenzi, ninawapa adhabu katika vitu hivi vyote vile, ili mtimize amri za Bwana. Pia, mtii wazee wenu na wote wanaowafundisha uadilifu.

Fanyeni kazi zenu kwa bidii, na mtapendwa mahali popote mnapoishi. Msive za mabishano, wasimulizi, wavivu wa mawazo, wajivuni, wala waseremala wa maneno. Kuwa wema, wenye heshima, na watulivu, kama inafaa kwa wasichana wachanga.

Muite Mungu kwa sala kwa hekima, na itawapatika. Jifunze kusoma na kuandika kwa bidii, muupende kazi huo, na mtakuwa wenye busara. Furahieni na mwimbieni zaburi, nyimbo, na nyimbo za kiroho. Jifunze kumpendeza Bwana tangu ujana wenu, kama wanawake watakatifu na bikira wa zamani walivyofanya. Esther pia alikuwa bikira ambaye alimcha Mungu; aliketi kwa unyenyekevu, alikuwa mwenye neema, heshima, wema, na moyo mnyenyekevu; kwa hiyo alimpendeza Mfalme Ahasuerusi kuliko bikira wengine wote. –tazama Estheri 2:17. Lakini hata akiwa juu ya hadhi yake hakujiona mwenye kiburi. Ingawa aling’ara kwa mavazi ya kifalme, alinyenyekea moyo wake kwa kufunga na kusali kwa Bwana, kwa ajili ya ndugu zake, ili wawaokolewe katika mikono ya maadui zao. Hakujiona kuwa bora kuliko mmoja wa ndugu zake walio wadogo kabisa.

Wakati mtakapofika umri wa kuelewa, hakikishieni mavyang’aro yenu kwa matendo ya Roho kama wema, upole, unyenyekevu, utiifu, uvumilivu, haki, haya, heshima, utakatifu, amani, ustahimilivu, huruma, hekima, bidii katika matendo mema, imani, matumaini na upendo. Mpende Mungu kuliko yote yaliyo duniani na mtendeni jirani yenu kama mnavyotaka watu wawatendee ninyi. –tazama Wagalatia 5:22-23 na Tito 2:3-5. Mkumbuke kwamba Yesu alisema: …Utampenda Bwana Mungu wako kwa moyo wako wote, na kwa roho yako yote, na kwa akili zako zote. Hii ni amri ya kwanza na kuu. Na ya pili inafanana nayo, Utampenda jirani yako kama nafsi yako. Katika amri hizi mbili hutegemea sheria yote na manabii –Mathayo 22:37-40.

Tufurahie na tushangilie, tukamtoeni heshima yeye: kwa sababu harusi ya Mwanakondoo imekuja, na mke wake amejiandaa. Na kwake ulimpatikana kuvalishwa nguo nzuri, safi na nyeupe: kwa maana nguo hiyo nzuri ni haki ya watakatifu –Ufunuo 19:7-8. Bana zangu, huu ni upambo wa watakatifu; fanyeni kazi ya kufaika kwa nguo ya ndoa hiyo, ili mwingie kwenye ndoa ya Mwanakondoo, ambapo wao …waadilifu, [wata] ang’aa kama jua katika ufalme wa Baba yao… –Mathayo 13:43. Mwari awaongoze kama alivyowaongoza Waisraeli kutoka Misri, na awailete Yerusalemu Mpya, ili tuweze kukuonana kwa furaha siku ya kufufuka. Ninawakabidhi kwa Bwana, Mungu wa Abrahamu, Mungu wa Isaka, na Mungu wa Yakobo; na amiwahifadhi hadi mwisho wa maisha yenu.

Mwisho, Ee watoto wangu wapendwa, nimeyandika haya kwa machozi, nikiwatoa adhabu kwa upendo. Sala yangu na wasiwasi wangu ni kwa ajili ya wokovu wenu kila wakati. Natumai na kuomba kila wakati kwamba Yeye, kwa rehema yake, atawalinda, kama vile alivyomlinda Yusufu, Musa, na Danieli katikati ya watu waovu. Na atafanya hivyo kama mtajitahidi kufuata ukweli.

Huu ni kwaheri yangu ya mwisho, weredi zangu mpenzi. Kumbukeni kila mmoja kwa upendo; jifunze kwa bidii kusoma na kuandika na muimie kila mtu katika yale yaliyo mema. Nawakemelea, watoto wangu wapendwa Betgen, David na Tanneken. Kwaheri ndugu na dada zangu wapendwa, na marafiki kila kona.

Imeandikwa na mimi, Soetgen van den Houte, mama yenu akiwa amefungwa; imeandikwa kwa haraka (akiwa anatetemeka kwa baridi), kwa upendo kwa nyote, ameni.
