Nou het Moses die skape van Jetro, sy skoonvader, die priester van Midian, opgepas; en hy het die skape na die agterkant van die woestyn gedryf en gekom by die berg van God, na Horeb – Eksodus 3:1.

Die agterkant van die woestyn word al lank verstaan as God se skool waar Hy baie van Sy dienaars opgevoed het, waarvan Moses die hoof is. Op die hoë ouderdom van 40 het hy homself bevind …geleer in al die wysheid van die Egiptenaars, en was kragtig in woorde en in dade. En toe hy veertig voljare was, het dit in sy hart gekom om sy broeders, die kinders van Israel, te besoek – Handelinge 7:22-23.

Ek twyfel nie dat God mense van groot vermoë, kapasiteit en opleiding kan en gebruik nie, maar geestelike leierskap verg ’n bestanddeel wat nie uit doen, bereik en verrig afsonderlik verkry word nie. Die ondergang van die ywerige mens is dikwels te min vertroue in God en te veel vertroue in die vlees. Hierdie trots en onrus word nie in ’n seminaar aangespreek nie en dit word oor die algemeen nie uitgeroei deur waaksaam plig nie. Vir baie van God se dienaars word dit uit die siel geëkstrak op die grond van onbewoonde sandvelde. Hierdie droë en verlate stuk grond wat lewendigheid en vrugbaarheid onttrek lyk, is waar baie dienaars leer om hul gesig in die stof te plaas en toe te gee aan wat as inaktiwiteit, onvrugbaarheid en verwerping mag voorkom.

Moses se lewe kan in drie afdelings verdeel word. Hy het sy eerste veertig jaar deurgebring om die wysheid van Egipte te leer, die volgende veertig as ’n skaapwagter in Midian, en ’n laaste veertig as die herder van Israel. Ons kan voorstel dat die eerste derde van sy pelgrimsreis gevul was met geweldige aktiwiteit, bevordering en prestasie. Dit was ongetwyfeld vir hom opgevoer dat by sy geboorte hy …uitermate mooi was en drie maande in sy vader se huis gevoed is – Handelinge 7:20.

Die wonderlike redding uit die rivier deur die filistin se dogter sou bevestig het dat hy bestem was om ’n instrument van God se goddelike ordening te wees. As ’n middelpunt van nasionale aandag is dit seker verstaanbaar hoe hierdie man wat …kragtig in woorde en in dade was – Handelinge 7:22, vol selfvertroue was in sy vermoë om God se opdrag uit te voer.

In vandag se ekonomie sou Moses as die ideale kandidaat vir kerkleiding beskou word. Hy was in elke opsig gekwalifiseer. Hy het bo sy mede-Egiptenare gestaan in opleiding, en hy het meer as normale natuurlike, finansiële en geestelike gawes gehad. Hy het uit die “Universiteit” van Egipte te voorskyn gekom as ’n man kragtig in woord en daad en hy het ’n duidelike roeping van God op sy lewe gehad. Hy was ’n konserwatiewe man wat verkies het …liewer verdrukking met die volk van God te ly as die genot van sonde vir ’n tyd – Hebreërs 11:25.

Tog, te midde van al sy goeie bekwaamhede was hy nog steeds onvoldoende vir die werk waarna God hom geroep het. En so het God hom gerieflik na die land Midian gelei om hom in ’n ander skool in te skryf om van die bittere kruie van teleurstelling en verwerping, verborgeheid en eensaamheid, en onvervulde drome en verlange te peusel. Terwyl dit vroeër sy ambisie was om hom vrywillig by die volk van God aan te sluit, is hierdie hoofstuk van sy lewe uitgedra deur dwang.

Ons leer uit die verslag in Eksodus dat die laaste derde van sy lewe gevul was met ingewikkelde betrokkenheid en groot bediening. Alhoewel die uittog uit Egipte ’n opwindende leesstof is en groot insig verskaf, kan die meeste van ons nie eerlik met die kragtige Moses en sy dinamiese samewerking met God vereenselwig nie. Dit is eerder die onopmerkbare 40-jaar middelstuk van sy lewe waarin baie van ons ons bevind. Hoewel daar slegs ’n paar dosyn verse is wat hierdie vier dekades van sy lewe voorstel, neem ons aan dat dit ’n deeglike skool was wat enorme geduld, sielsnavorsing en dalk ’n bietjie frustrasie ingeskryf het.

Vir ons verteenwoordig dit ’n tydperk wanneer die dor sand van tyd om ons oënskynlik niks meer vrugbaar lewer as ’n openbaring van ons droë, korsagtige hart nie—verkrimp en verkwis deur die gevolge van ons mislukkings en vorige sondes. Dit is in hierdie tye dat ons ’n afasie in geloof kan hê, nie dat ons God vir ons omstandighede blameer nie, maar dat ons ons lewens as nutteloos begin beskou en dat elke dag dieselfde is as die vorige. Miskien begin ons rondloop in ’n visielose stupor—deur ’n mis van geestelike depressie—terwyl ons tastend vir bemoediging en ’n herinnering soek dat God ons nie vergeet het nie. Soms lyk dit selfs asof ons gebede die plafon tref en terugkaats, wat naaklach en in gru-skarpery teen ons lieg dat ons bruikbaarheid in die Koninkryk van God verby is. Tydens verlengde tye van beproewing en toetsing voel ons verwerp. Ons kan selfs voorstel dat God teen ons gekeer het. Ons kyk op na die Hemel en vra: “Waarom, Here?” Ons sal nooit verwerping en verlaat wees in die mate ervaar wat die Here Jesus ervaar het nie, maar wanneer ons dit in ons geringelike klein sfeer ervaar, lyk dit asof dit al ons geestelike krag en lewenskrag uitput. Ons dink… As die Here veertig jaar hiervan van ons sou vereis sou daar geen tyd oorbly in ons lewens om op te bou op wat ons geleer het nie. Maar God se tyding is perfek. Dus is dit gepas dat ons onsself nie te veel oor die lengte van ons vorming bekommer nie, maar deeglik vertroud raak met die boodskap van Midian. Terwyl sommige die bittere slae van Midian ontvang en terugtrek om sarkasties aan die kantlyn te staan, moet ons die stof van die woestyn afskud en opstaan met ’n begrip van…

God se Doel

God het ’n doel vir elke besonderheid van ons lewens. Hy kan ons in ’n moeilike posisie plant om ’n nuwe roeping in ons te smeed. Dit was alleen in Midian waar Moses van sy eie trots, selfvertroue, gebrek aan geloof en die verbete dwaasheid waaraan sy eie hande deelgeneem het, geleer het. Hier in sy Midian was hy alleen en tog nie alleen nie; talle ander heiliges het hom daar vergesel. Die seuns van Jakob en die vrou van Potifars het ’n ander lewenskragtige dienaar daarheen gestuur—Josef. Die wilde woede van ’n jaloerse koning het ’n begaafde jong harpist daarheen gestuur. Selfs ’n ou en dwase koning wat geweier het om geleer te word, het homself in ’n wildernis bevind en gras geëet soos ’n os totdat hy van sy trots teruggekrabbel het.

Deur die blaaie van die geskiedenis het ontelbare heiliges besef dat ‘hoe donkerder die vallei, hoe meer het ek leer bid’. Terwyl hulle by die drumpel van die nuwe dag aankom en oorstroom is van oorvloedige uitbundigheid, word hulle gou kaalgeskud in ’n metamorfose en eindelik kom hulle te voorskyn met niks anders as die staf van God in hul hande nie. Verby is die dae toe hulle vinnig praat, vinnig optree en traag luister. In Midian leer die student om sy fokus te verskuif van “Ek sal groot dinge vir God doen” na “Wat wil U hê ek moet doen?”

En hy beef en was verbaas en het gesê: Here, wat wil U hê ek moet doen? En die Here het tot hom gesê: Staak op en gaan in die dorp, en daar sal vir jou gesê word wat jy doen moet – Handelinge 9:6. Die nuwe aankomelinge in Midian het baie antwoorde, maar die meeste daarvan behels ’n een-akter met self as die hoofkarakter. Die gegradueerdes stap stil en ernstig uit, want hulle het deur die uitmergelende proses van skeiding van die vlees van die gees gegaan wat berokken is deur…

God se Suiwering

Die sondaar is vir silwer en die smeltkroes vir goud, maar die HERE beproef die harte – Spreuke 17:3. Toe Moses deur die poorte van Midian gegaan het, was die eerste toneel wat God voor sy oë gesit het ’n ongeregtigheid by ’n put. En die priester van Midian het sewe dogters gehad… – Eksodus 2:16, wat deur ’n trop onedelde herders weggejaag is. Maar Moses was deeglik opgevoed in elke dimensie van die Egiptiese plutokrasie, wat alle aspekte van militêre kundigheid en wereldse leierskapvaardighede ingesluit het. Daarom, toe hy ingryp om die hulpelose skaapwagtersdogters te help, sou hy heeltemal in staat gewees het om dit te doen. Hierdie dogters van die priester van Midian het die hulp waardeer wat hulle aan hul vader teruggesê het dat …’n Egiptenaar ons uit die hande van die herders verlos het en ook genoeg water getrek en die skape gewater het – Eksodus 2:19. Toe hulle vader, Ruel, hierdie verhaal hoor, was hy so beïndruk dat hy vir Moses ’n onthaal, ’n werk en ’n vrou gegee het… alles in een vers. – sien Eksodus 2:21.

…Julle weet dat hulle wat beskou word as heersers oor die nasies, oor hulle heers; en hul grootes oefen mag oor hulle uit – Markus 10:42. Terwyl Moses se strewe na geregtigheid edel mag gewees het, was sy oriëntasie bloot heidens. Dit mag werk om die pikorde in ’n hoenderhok te bepaal, maar dit is bestem om te misluk in die leiding van God se volk. Maar julle sal nie so wees nie; maar wie onder julle groot wil wees, sal julle dienaar wees; en wie van julle die eerste wil wees, sal julle die slaaf van almal wees – Markus 10:43-44.

Hierdie leerstelling was vreemdeling aan Egipte en ook aan Moses. Baie goed en begaafde manne kan suksesvol ’n besigheid bedryf deur heidense gesag uit te oefen, maar dit werk selde in hul huis en dit is nog minder doeltreffend in ’n kerk. Dus het God Sy gekose vat van koninklike stand na proletariaat (die werklende klas) beweeg, amper oornag. Hy is toe gegee ’n werk wat deur die mense wat hom opgelei het verag is—…want elke skaapwagter is ’n gruwel vir die Egiptenaars – Genesis 46:34. Hierdie smeltkroes is nie net om ons ’n broodnodige les te leer nie, maar om ons te lei in…

God se Voorziening

Die nederiges sal Hy lei in regspraak; en die nederiges sal Hy onderrig in sy weg – Psalm 25:9. God sal ons nooit op die agterkant van die woestyn verlaat nie; eerder pas Hy ons lewensomstandighede aan om ons in Sy volheid te bring. As ons die versoeking om ’n houding van woede aan te kweek weerstaan, sal God ons sy weë kan leer. Maar vir Moses het die situasie hom so voorgestel dat God se goddelike leiding die laaste ding was wat hy sou vermoed het wat gebeur het.

Gebeur…? Dit het gelyk asof niks gebeur nie. Die weke het in maande oorgegaan, die maande in jare, en die jare in dekades, terwyl die begaafde Moses ’n onderpresterende skaapwagter gebly het. Een van die moeilikste dinge waarmee ons worstel, is “wag.” Byna elke Christen sal ’n lang tyd van verdrukking teëkom en ons word vertel om: …dit nie vreemd te agten aangaande die vuurproef wat oor julle kom nie, asof ’n vreemde ding met julle gebeur – 1 Petrus 4:12. Maar ons moet nie God se middele oordeel deur ons swak sin nie, want intussen berei die wonderlike werk van wag ons voor vir…

God se Bevordering

38, 39, … 40 jaar. Kom nou daarom, en ek sal jou na Farao stuur, dat jy my volk, die kinders van Israel, uit Egipte mag bring – Eksodus 3:10.

Miskien is God bekoorlik deur die getal 40, maar meer waarskynlik was dit die tyd wat dit geneem het vir Moses om by die stoel van oorwinning uit te kom. Sy selfagting is volkome uitgeblus, en hy vra nederig: …Wie is ek, dat ek na Farao sal gaan en die kinders van Israel uit Egipte sal bring? – Eksodus 3:11.

Moses was nie minder gekwalifiseerd as wat hy veertig jaar vroeër was nie, maar sy veronderstelling het in die hitte van die woestynson verdwyn. Die ervaring wat in die ruwe weivelde met die koppige skape verwerf is, het hom tot die begrip gebring dat dit amper ’n onmoontlike taak sal wees. Maar daar is geen geordineerde roeping wat onafhanklik van… uitgereik word nie.

God se Belofte

…Ek sal sekerlik by jou wees; en dit sal vir jou ’n teeken wees dat Ek jou gestuur het: en wanneer jy die volk uit Egipte uitgebring het, sal julle God dien op hierdie berg – Eksodus 3:12.

Nie dat Moses volmaakheid bereik het nie, want ons vind Moses wat God tot toorn prikkel in die volgende hoofstuk—En die toorn van die HERE het teen Moses gebrand… – Eksodus 4:14. Toe was hy binne ’n kort tyd weer die direkte voorwerp op die pad van God se swaard—En dit het gebeur onderweg in die herberg dat die HERE hom ontmoet en probeer het om hom te slaan dood – Eksodus 4:24. Tog, selfs al is sy vat nog van klei, het dit ’n verhitting ondergaan wat hom voorberei het vir die Here se diens, en vir ons sal God nie Sy beloftes herroep in die wind van ons gril nie. Dus het die groot EK IS WIE EK IS – sien Eksodus 3:14, ’n geweldige en ewige taak op menslike skouers gelê om Sy volk te lei. Maar hierdie opdrag moet nie uitgevoer word sonder…

God se Krag

Wat was die werklike verfyning uit die tyd wat Moses in die woestyn deurgebring het? Ons merk sy oorhaastige bereidheid om die swaard te swaai voor sy aankoms, maar by sy uittog het hy net ’n staf in sy hand gedra. Met die swaard het hy ’n Egiptenaar oorwin, maar met die staf het hy die hele magte van Egipte oorwin. Die staf van God het water in die woestyn gebring. Dit was die staf van God wat, toe dit deur flou hande hoog opgelig is, die oorwinning oor Amalek beveilig het. Wat is die staf van God? Voor sy dae in Midian het hy dit skaars geken. Veertig jaar later is daar byna geen toneel sonder dit nie.

Die staf is God se krag tot heil. Dit is God se wysheid, God se waarheid, God se getuienis, maar meer as al hierdie is dit God se teregstelling. Sonder dit ontvang en besef mens nie die liefde van God nie, want sonder dit is mens nie aan God gekoppel nie. Want wie die Here liefhet, die teregstreep Hy, en wie Hy as ’n seun ontvang, die gesel Hy. As julle die teregstelling verdra, sal God met julle optree as met seuns; want watter seun is daar wat die vader nie teregstreep nie? Maar as julle sonder teregstelling is, waarvan almal deelagtig is, dan is julle bastaarde en nie seuns nie – Hebreërs 12:6-8.

Dieselfde Moses, wat eens bereid was om heerskappy (heidense gesag) oor God se volk uit te oefen, vind homself nou smekend tot God om Sy gramskap van hulle weg te keer. Die mense wat Moses daarvan beskuldig het dat hy hulle uitgelei het om hulle dood te maak en selfs op ’n stadium gereed was om hom te stenig, is nou die middelpunt van sy hart en toegeneentheid, al is hulle die oorsaak van sy mislukking om die beloofde land te binnedring. Dit is die liefde van Christus. Maar waar word dit geleer anders as onder die staf van God, op die agterkant van die woestyn, in die Egiptiese kerkers, in die grotte van Adullam, in die noue plekke van Arabië, en in die stil eensaamheid van die agterstoof waar God bestem het dat baie van Sy mense moet gaan totdat hulle leer om …by My te leer; want Ek is sagmoedig en nederig van hart: en julle sal rus vind vir julle siele – Matteus 11:29. Sekerlik is dit waar Moses die karakter verwerf het wat by die Bybelse geleerde bekend is as die sagmoedigste man wat ooit op die aarde gewandel het. Sekerlik is daar geen meer teenstrydige plek op die aarde om dit te leer nie as in die skool van lyding.

En so sal ons ook hier vertoef, sodat ons …hom mag ken en die krag van sy opstanding en die deelgenootskap van sy lydinge, en dat ons na sy dood gevorm mag word – Filippense 3:10.

“Dr. Waldron,” the lady sitting across from me said. “I have been struggling a lot lately.”

“Tell me what’s going on,” I said.

“I don’t know how to explain it,” she hesitated… “I just feel tired most of the time. I can’t concentrate anymore, and I just don’t enjoy most of the things that I used to enjoy. I’m getting through my days, but that’s about it. Do you think I have a thyroid problem or am low in some mineral or vitamin?”

“That could be,” I told her. “We can certainly check those things, but I think something else is going on here.”

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

I am a family doctor and probably thirty percent of the people who come to my office to see me have symptoms of depression. This doesn’t mean that they are on medication for it or feel that they need special help, but it does say that these symptoms are widespread in our world.

Even in Christian circles, surveys indicate that about 15 percent of Christians self-report having been diagnosed with depression at some point in their life. This is 25 percent lower than in society as a whole, but it is still higher than we would like to believe.

In the very beginning, God created the world and Adam and Eve. And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good… –Genesis 1:31. Before the Fall, everything was perfect.

I don’t think we know entirely what this meant. Obviously, there were no physical diseases or maladies to afflict either the humans or the flora and fauna of Eden. More than that, Adam and Eve didn’t suffer from anxiety or depression. Their hormones didn’t get out of balance, they didn’t get stressed out (even if there could have been stress in a perfect garden), and they wouldn’t have gotten upset or angry at any point.

Everything changed with Adam and Eve sinning. We see this in the tension between them after they ate the fruit with Adam blaming Eve, and Eve blaming the snake. And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat. And the LORD God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat –Genesis 3:12-13.

Feeding a family suddenly became hard work. Viruses and bacteria became pathogenic and at some point, in the first families, people would have begun to struggle with emotional and mental health challenges.

Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee. And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life; Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field; In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return –Genesis 3:16-19.

I would like to explore what depression is as defined by the medical world, some of the sources of it, and then discuss how we can deal with it, both in our own lives and in the lives of our friends and family.

Diagnosing Depression

As mentioned earlier, many people have some symptoms of depression. They may feel more fatigued, cry easily, or have other symptoms that aren’t usual for them. Most of them do not actually have true clinical depression.

Most people do not have all of these symptoms, but when they are continually present without dissipating for two weeks or more, especially if they are strong enough to hinder normal day-to-day responsibilities or the ability to get proper rest, then it is time to do something.

It is important to remember that there is a large or broad continuum regarding depression. Some people have mild discouragement, some have deep feelings of sadness, and some have enough depression that they are at risk to cause harm to themselves or others.

Causes of Depression

There are different examples of people in the Bible who seem to have exhibited symptoms consistent with depression. Two of them stand out to me.

First is Naomi. We know that she went with her husband and her two sons to Moab because of a famine that was affecting southern Israel. She spent ten years in this foreign land and during that time, her husband and both of her sons died.

The book of Ruth tells us that when she returned to Bethlehem, she said to the people, …Call me not Naomi [pleasant], call me Mara [bitter]: for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me. I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me home again empty: why then call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me? –Ruth 1:20-21.

There is no way to interview Naomi and find out all the things that she was feeling, but this seems to be more than simple grief. She had lost all the things that were of value to her, and to her it seemed that even God had turned against her.

As we read the story of Ruth, we see that things did improve for her throughout the book—mostly through the ministry of her daughter-in-law, Ruth, but also, through God gradually restoring things of value back into her life, and through others encouraging her in the Lord’s goodness. And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be the LORD, which hath not left thee this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Israel. And he shall be unto thee a restorer of thy life, and a nourisher of thine old age: for thy daughter in law, which loveth thee, which is better to thee than seven sons, hath born him. And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it –Ruth 4:14-16.

Another one that comes to mind is the Prophet Jeremiah. Jeremiah was called when he was a young man, and he had a very long career speaking God’s Word to a group of kings and other people who simply weren’t interested in what he had to say.

Jeremiah’s life was constantly under threat. At one time, he was thrown into a dungeon full of mud and was only rescued at the last minute. Jerusalem was besieged three different times before the Babylonians razed it. Through his decades of ministry, Jeremiah told the people what God was asking of them, and the people constantly ignored it.

Perhaps it is no wonder that Jeremiah is known today as the weeping prophet. He said, Cursed be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed. Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto thee; making him very glad. And let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide … Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame? –Jeremiah 20:14-18.

It is important to note that in both of these examples from the Bible, sin is not revealed to be the issue (or the reason) that pushed these people into depression. For Naomi it was probably a mixture of isolation from her homeland and loss of people she loved dearly. For Jeremiah, it was the constant stress of trying to serve God in a nation that didn’t care about God.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

Depression is always multi-factorial. That is to say, there are usually a mixture of internal and external factors that break a person down.

There are genetic and hormonal components that come into play here. There is no doubt that some individuals and some families are more prone to depression than others. It is thought by many doctors and researchers that changes in genes which transport the chemical, Serotonin, through the brain can make some people more susceptible to depression than others.

These differences in genetic makeup can help us understand why some people require very little stress to bring them down, while others seem very resilient. Since we can’t change our genetic makeup, there is no sense gloating if we have a more upbeat personality than someone else. And, if we recognize that we have a greater tendency towards depression, we don’t need to feel discouraged by this fact. If God created us in such a way that we tend towards being moody instead of being naturally upbeat, we need to use wisdom in doing what we can to manage as many external factors as we can so as to minimize the risk of debilitating (extreme) depression.

External stressors are often the thing that triggers these sorts of feelings (discouragement). It can be the death of a close friend or family member, or it can be a financial misfortune. It is important to remember that even good events can produce large amounts of stress. Mothers with newborns are often functioning on very little sleep, even while they have large physical changes taking place in their bodies.

Some people may have poor coping skills. Unfortunately, many turn to street drugs or alcohol to try to smother the feelings that they can’t control otherwise.

As a final thing, sin and guilt can trigger depression or make it worse. We can see this present in David and Saul’s lives. (See Psalm chapter 32) This is not to say that all depression is the result of sin—far from it—but sin needs to be dealt with, and repented of, in order to move forward.

Perhaps as a side note, I will mention that in my experience, deeply depressed people often struggle with horrible guilt. They don’t even know what sin they might have committed; they are only certain that God is angry with them, and they must have done something wrong. Fixing the depression will help with the assurance of salvation issues that these people tend to deal with.

This leaves us with the question of how to help someone who is dealing with this sort of thinking.

Listen

Listening is a powerful tool for helping other people. Listen actively and without jumping in to interrupt negative thinking.

You may be able to see that all is not terrible and that there is much positive in the world. The fact that they can’t see these things has more to do with their mindset than with how terrible things really are. A person struggling with depression may know that there are people worse off in the world, but it doesn’t really help them much to point that out to them.

Encourage

Encouragement can simply be saying good things that you see in the life of the person who is struggling. This is something that all of us need more of.

More than this, we need to encourage people to do things that are healthy for themselves. They need to get out of their home, they should try to exercise, and they should make an attempt to eat healthy. We can help them do better in all of these areas. (See Galatians 6:2)

Pray

…The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much –James 5:16.

These people need someone to pray with them. They need someone to pray for them. Jesus asks us to pray in secret, but it is also really encouraging for someone who is struggling to hear themselves being prayed for. This helps them to know that there are many people who are lifting them up with prayer support.

Be Willing to be the Initiator

People with depression have very low energy levels. Beyond that, they don’t see themselves as having any value. At least such that someone else would want to spend time with them. They aren’t going to call or text, and they certainly won’t set up a lunch meeting or prayer time.

Even though they crave all of these things, it is just really difficult for them to take the first step to reach out to others. It therefore falls to the rest of us to be willing to do those things.

Don’t Jump to Conclusions

We know the story of Job’s friends. They rode up to see Job after disaster fell on him and sat quietly in shock for several days upon seeing the devastation that had happened to him. When they finally began to speak, it was to judge him for the terrible sin they assumed he had committed.

It isn’t wrong to ask about sin, but there are plenty of times where depression isn’t sin-related. Focusing in on sin prematurely, or if it is assumed, will simply drive wedges that will make it less likely that you can help a person find healing.

What if you are the person struggling with depression? How should you deal with it and what things can help?

Deal With Issues Early

Everyone has moments when they are stressed out and really discouraged. We use terms like “burn-out” and “compassion fatigue” in the medical field when people are heading in the wrong direction. These struggles manifest themselves when we are being irritable with the people around us, when we’re feeling tired most of the time, or when we’re feeling discouraged most of the time. When we see that these symptoms are popping up, it is time to do something to keep things from getting worse.

Maybe a first step is simply knowing our limitations. There are times where we will simply need to say no to work projects or even to church activities because it doesn’t leave us sufficient time to rest. Certain times of the year could be worse—many people struggle more during the winter months because of less sunlight.

Cutting back in whatever areas we can is important when we see that we are on the wrong trajectory.

Don’t Do Comparisons

Everyone is different. Identifying people who seem to “have it altogether” when you are struggling doesn’t help you and it probably will make you feel worse.

Struggling with discouragement does not mean that you aren’t a Christian or that God is done with you. It means that you are human living in a fallen world. You don’t want to continue to live with a depressed spirit, but neither should you believe that you are the only one who has dealt with this. (See 2 Corinthians 10:12)

Exercise

Cardiovascular exercise is really important to boost the chemicals in the brain that are associated with depression. It doesn’t really matter what type of exercise you do. What does matter, is that it increases your heart rate 25 to 30 percent above your baseline heart rate.

Exercise is something that is hard to do, even when you aren’t dealing with depression. It is particularly hard when you are fatigued and feeling down.

Spend Time with Encouragers

People need community. When we are dealing with depressive feelings, we really need other people around to lift us up, to pray with us, and to give us encouragement. None of us is better from spending extended times alone. (See Proverbs 27:17)

Deal with Sin

Sin can make prayer feel ineffective. That isn’t to say that simply confessing sin will suddenly make someone’s depression lift, but it is an important part of reaching healing. Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed… –James 5:16.

Be Willing to Take Medication

Not everyone needs medication. The hope is that if you do the right (helpful) things (some of which are listed above), you can keep things from getting bad enough that you would need medical help. But there are plenty of situations where someone simply needs to start on some medication in order to aid them in a number of ways: to sleep, to rest a weary mind that will not stop, to dull the emotional pain, etc.

People with severe enough depression may be a risk to themselves. They may even be completely unable to respond to counseling or any of the other non-medical treatments for these feelings. These people really need to start on medication with the goal to transition off of those medications down the road when they are thinking clearly enough to continue on the right path.

Unfortunately, the benefits of these medications seem to be short-lived. Long-term use of antidepressant medications really does not seem to improve quality of life for many patients. A recent study looked at patients who took antidepressant medications and compared them to those who did not and found similar levels of health-related quality of life in the two groups. In other words, when comparing two groups of depressed patients, with the one group taking medication and the other group not, after a period of time (approximately 6 months) there were no longer any observable differences in their depression levels. So, while these medications may help to stabilize a person who has severe depression, after a period of time the actual medical “help” of the medication starts to diminish. Hopefully, by this time, the person will be stable enough that a safe taper can be taken towards weaning off the medication.

With this in mind, it is very important to do things other than medication to attempt to improve the situation.

Continue, Even When You Feel Better

Many times, when someone has a medical issue, they will consciously change their diet and lifestyle to improve their situation. The problem is that when the symptoms get better, the tendency is to fall back into old eating and behavioral patterns.

If you have dealt with depression in the past, it is important that you continue a path of healthy choices. Exercise regularly, eat healthy meals, manage your stress level (as much as you can), don’t over-schedule, and make a conscious effort to meet regularly with godly friends for times of prayer and support.

Periodically take an inventory of how you are doing. If you are struggling, figure out what you are going to change to make things better.

Depression is very common in our society and in our churches. We can have victory over it alone, but with God’s help and with the support of Christian brothers and sisters, we can move forward.

You may not be gloriously happy all of the time, but by God’s grace, you will have the joy of the Lord in your heart, even on the most stressful days.

“瓦尔德伦医生，”坐在我对面的那位女士说。“我最近一直很挣扎。”

“告诉我发生了什么事，”我说。

“我不知道该怎么解释，”她犹豫着……“我大部分时间都觉得很疲惫。我不能再集中注意力了，我也不再享受以前喜欢的大多数事情。我只是勉强过完每天的日子，仅此而已。你认为我有甲状腺问题，还是缺某种矿物质或维生素？”

“那有可能，”我告诉她。“我们当然可以检查那些东西，但我认为这里面还有别的原因。”

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

我是家庭医生，大约百分之三十来看我的病人有抑郁的症状。这并不意味着他们都在服药或认为自己需要特殊帮助，但这表明这些症状在我们这个世界中相当普遍。

即便在基督教圈子中，调查显示约有15%的基督徒自报一生中的某个时期被诊断为抑郁症。这比整个社会的比例低大约25%，但仍比我们希望相信的要高。

起初，上帝创造了世界和亚当与夏娃。并且神看着一切所造的都甚好……（创世记 1:31）。在堕落之前，一切都是完美的。

我并不认为我们完全明白这意味着什么。显然，那时没有身体疾病或病痛会折磨伊甸园里的人的身体或动植物。更加甚者，亚当和夏娃没有饱受焦虑或抑郁之苦。他们的荷尔蒙不会失衡，他们不会承受压力（即便在完美的园中也可能有某种压力），他们也不会在任何时候感到烦恼或愤怒。

亚当和夏娃犯罪后，一切都变了。我们在他们吃了那果子后彼此间的紧张关系中看到了这一点：亚当责怪夏娃，夏娃责怪那蛇。那人对女人说：“你所赐给我、与我同居的女人，她把那树上的果子给我，我就吃了。”耶和华神对女人说：“你做的是什么事呢？”女人说：“那蛇引诱我，我就吃了。”（创世记 3:12-13）

养家变得突然艰难起来。病毒和细菌成了致病因子，在最初的家庭中，人的情绪和心理健康在某个时期便会开始受苦。

又对女人说：我要多多加增你怀胎的苦楚；你生产儿女必多受苦楚；你必恋慕你丈夫，你丈夫必管辖你。又对亚当说：你因听从妻子的话，吃了我所吩咐你不可吃的那树上的果子，地为你的缘故受咒诅；你必终身劳苦，才能从地里得吃的。地必给你长出荆棘和蒺藜来，你也要吃田间的菜蔬。你必汗流满面才得糊口，直到你归了土，因你是从土而出的；你本是尘土，仍要归于尘土。（创世记 3:16-19）

我想探讨一下医学界如何定义抑郁，它的一些成因，然后讨论我们如何在自己和亲友的生活中应对它。

抑郁的诊断

如前所述，许多人有一些抑郁的症状。他们可能觉得更易疲劳、容易哭泣，或有其他并非他们平常会有的症状。但大多数人并不是真正的临床性抑郁症。

大多数人不会出现下列所有症状，但当这些症状持续存在并在两周或更长时间内没有消退，尤其是强烈到足以妨碍日常职责或影响正常休息时，就该采取行动了。

重要的是要记住，抑郁存在一个大而宽广的连续体。有些人只是轻微的沮丧，有些人有深切的悲伤感，有些人的抑郁严重到会对自己或他人构成伤害的风险。

抑郁的成因

圣经中有不同的人物似乎表现出与抑郁相符的症状。其中两位在我心中尤为显著。

首先是拿俄米。我们知道她因着影响以色列南部的饥荒，与丈夫和两个儿子迁往摩押。她在这异乡住了十年，在此期间，她的丈夫和两个儿子都死了。

路得记告诉我们，当她回到伯利恒时，她对众人说：“不要称我拿俄米（意思是‘愉快’），要称我玛拉（意思是‘苦’）；因为全能者使我大大受苦。我满出去，耶和华使我空回来；耶和华向我发烈怒，全能者使我受惊。”（路得记 1:20-21）

无法对拿俄米进行访谈以了解她当时心中所有的感受，但这似乎不仅仅是简单的悲伤。她失去了所有对她有价值之物，并且在她看来，连上帝似乎也转向了她。

当我们读路得的故事时，看到她的处境在全书过程中有所好转——主要通过她媳妇路得的服侍，同时也是通过上帝逐渐将有价值的事物恢复到她生命中，以及他人在主里的鼓励。“妇人对拿俄米说：愿耶和华赐福与那没有撇下你，今日使你有近亲者的，他在以色列要使他名闻；他要为你作兴旺你的，扶养你老年的人，因为那爱你的儿媳，比七个儿子还强。”拿俄米就抱着孩子，放在自己怀中，作他的奶子。（路得记 4:14-16）

另一个让我想到的是先知耶利米。耶利米在年轻时蒙召，他有很长的服事生涯，向一群王和其他人传讲神的话，而这些人往往对他所说的毫无兴趣。

耶利米的生命常受到威胁。有一次，他被扔进满是泥的监牢，直到最后一刻才被救出。耶路撒冷在被巴比伦毁灭之前，被围困了三次。在数十年的服事中，耶利米向百姓传神的吩咐，百姓却不断地置之不理。

也许不足为奇，耶利米今日被称为哭泣的先知。他说：“我生的日子遇见祸，生我的日子不为福。那人把消息带给我父亲，说：‘我生了一个男子。’就使他甚快乐，那人该受咒诅；那使我父亲欢喜的人，若不悔改，就当像耶和华所倾覆的城邑。愿早晨听见哀声，午间听见呼叫声。我出母腹，为何出来自见劳苦忧愁，使我度日羞辱呢？”（耶利米书 20:14-18）

值得注意的是，在这两个圣经例子中，并没有显明罪是把这些人推进抑郁的根本问题（或理由）。对拿俄米来说，这很可能是因离乡背井的隔离感与失去挚爱之人的混合；对耶利米来说，则是持续在一个不关心上帝的国中为神服事所承受的压力。

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

抑郁总是多因素的。也就是说，通常是内在与外在因素的混合把人压垮。

遗传和荷尔蒙因素在这里起作用。毫无疑问，某些个体和某些家庭比其他人更容易患抑郁。许多医生和研究人员认为，传送脑内化学物质血清素的基因变化会使某些人比他人更易罹患抑郁。

这些基因差异可以帮助我们理解为什么有些人在很小的压力下就会崩溃，而有些人看起来很有韧性。既然我们无法改变自己的基因构成，如果我们天性比别人更开朗，也没有必要自鸣得意。反之，若我们认识到自己更倾向于情绪化而非天然乐观，也不必因此灰心。如果上帝造我们时使我们倾向情绪多变而非天性开朗，我们需要以智慧去管理尽可能多的外在因素，以将致残性（极端）抑郁的风险降到最低。

外在压力常常是触发这些情感（沮丧）的导火索。可能是亲友或家人的死亡，或是财务不幸。重要的是记住，即便是好事件也能产生大量压力。初为人母者常常睡眠不足，同时她们体内也发生巨大生理变化。

有些人可能缺乏良好的应对技巧。不幸的是，许多人转向街头毒品或酒精来压抑那些他们无法以其他方式控制的情绪。

最后，罪与内疚能触发抑郁或使之恶化。我们在大卫和扫罗的生命中可以看到这一点。（见诗篇第32篇）这并不是说所有抑郁都是罪的结果——远非如此——但罪需要被处理并悔改，才能向前迈进。

或许作为旁注，我会提到，在我的经验中，深度抑郁的人常常与可怕的内疚感挣扎。他们甚至不知道自己可能犯了什么罪；他们只确信上帝在生他们的气，他们肯定做错了什么。纠正抑郁将有助于这些人在救恩确据问题上的挣扎。

这就留下了一个问题：如何帮助正在经历这种思维模式的人？

倾听

倾听是帮助他人的强有力工具。积极地倾听，且不要插话去打断消极的思维。

你可能能看到事情并非如此糟糕，世界上有许多积极的方面。他们看不到这些更多地与他们的心态有关，而不是事物本身有多糟。与抑郁挣扎的人可能知道世上有人处境更糟，但指出这一点对他们并没有多大帮助。

鼓励

鼓励可以只是说出你在那位挣扎者生命中所见的好事。这是我们所有人都需要更多的事情。

更进一步，我们需要鼓励人去做对他们健康有益的事。他们需要走出家门，尝试锻炼，尽力吃得健康。我们可以帮助他们在这些方面做得更好。（参见加拉太书 6:2）

祷告

……义人祈祷所发的力量是大有功效的。（雅各书 5:16）

这些人需要有人与他们一起祷告。他们需要有人为他们祷告。耶稣要求我们在暗中祷告，但对正在挣扎的人来说，听到有人为自己祷告也确实是很大的鼓励。这帮助他们知道有许多人正在以祷告支持他们。

愿意主动发起

抑郁的人精力很低。更重要的是，他们看不到自己的价值，至少看不到别人会愿意与他们共度时光的价值。他们不会打电话或发短信，当然也不会安排午餐或祷告聚会。

尽管他们渴望这一切，但他们要迈出第一步去联系他人确实很困难。因此，责任落在我们其余人身上，要愿意去做这些事。

不要轻率下结论

我们知道约伯朋友的故事。祸患临到约伯时，他们骑马来见他，见到他遭遇的灾难后默坐几天，当他们终于开口时，便以他们认为约伯所犯的可怕罪来论断他。

询问是否有罪并非错误，但有很多时候抑郁并非与罪相关。过早地或默认地把焦点放在罪上，只会造成隔阂，使你更难帮助一个人找到医治。

如果你自己正在与抑郁挣扎呢？你该如何处理，哪些事情会有帮助？

及早处理问题

每个人都有感到压力重重和极度沮丧的时刻。我们在医学界用“职业倦怠”和“怜悯疲劳”这样的词来描述人们在走上错误方向时的状态。这些挣扎在我们对周围人变得易怒、几乎总是感到疲倦或常常感到沮丧时表现出来。当我们看到这些症状出现时，就该采取措施防止情况恶化。

或许第一步就是认识自己的极限。有时我们确实需要对工作项目甚至教会活动说“不”，因为那样会让我们没有足够的时间休息。某些季节可能更糟——许多人在冬季因日照减少而更易挣扎。

在看到自己走上错误轨迹时，在我们能做的领域里削减负担很重要。

不要做比较

每个人都不同。在你挣扎时去认定那些看似“事事都处理得很好”的人，并不会帮助你，反而可能让你感觉更糟。

与沮丧挣扎并不意味着你不是基督徒，也不意味着上帝已经放弃你。这意味着你是一个生活在堕落世界中的人。你不想继续生活在抑郁的心境中，但你也不应相信自己是唯一经历过这种事的人。（参见哥林多后书 10:12）

锻炼

心血管运动对提升与抑郁相关的大脑化学物质非常重要。做哪种运动并不关键，关键是它能使你的心率比基线提高25%到30%。

锻炼本来就不易做到，即便你并未应对抑郁。更何况在你疲倦并情绪低落时尤其难以坚持。

与鼓励你的人共度时光

人需要群体。当我们面对抑郁情绪时，我们确实需要他人在身边扶持我们、与我们同祷，并给我们鼓励。长时间独处对任何人都无益。（参见箴言 27:17）

处理罪

罪会使祷告感觉无效。这并不是说单纯认罪就会立刻使人的抑郁消失，但这是达到医治的重要部分。“你们要彼此认罪，互相代祷，使你们可以得医治……”（雅各书 5:16）

愿意服药

并不是每个人都需要药物。希望是如果你做对了（有帮助的）事情（其中一些在上文列出），可以阻止病情恶化到需要医学帮助的地步。但也有很多情况下，某人确实需要开始服用某种药物，以在若干方面协助他们：帮助入睡、使不停止思考的疲惫心灵得以安宁、缓和情感痛苦等。

抑郁严重的人可能对自己构成危险。他们甚至可能完全无法对咨询或任何其他非药物治疗作出反应。这类人确实需要开始服药，目标是将来在他们思路清楚到足以继续走正确道路时，逐步停药。

不幸的是，这些药物的益处似乎是短暂的。抗抑郁药的长期使用对于许多患者并不显著改善生活质量。一项近期研究对比服用抗抑郁药与未服药的患者，发现两组在与健康相关的生活质量方面处于相似水平。换言之，在比较两组抑郁患者——一组服药、另一组不服药——经过一段时间（约6个月）后，再也观察不到两组在抑郁程度上的差异。因此，尽管这些药物可能有助于稳定严重抑郁的病人，但经过一段时间后，药物的实际“帮助”开始减弱。希望到那时，病人已经足够稳定，可以安全地逐步减量并停药。

鉴于此，非常重要的一点是，除了药物之外，还要做其他事情来改善状况。

即便感觉好转也要持续下去

许多时候，当某人有了健康问题时，他们会有意识地改变饮食和生活方式以改善状况。问题在于，当症状好转时，人们往往又会回到旧的饮食和行为模式。

如果你过去曾与抑郁抗争过，继续走健康选择的道路很重要。定期锻炼，吃健康膳食，尽可能管理好你的压力水平，不要过度安排日程，并有意识地定期与敬虔的朋友聚会，彼此祷告和支持。

定期检查自己处境。如果你在挣扎，找出你将改变什么以使情况更好。

抑郁在我们的社会和教会中非常普遍。我们可以单凭自己得胜，但在上帝的帮助和基督弟兄姊妹的支持下，我们可以向前迈进。

你不一定时时都欣喜若狂，但凭着上帝的恩典，即便在最有压力的日子里，你心中也会有主的喜乐。

Greetings of love in Jesus’ name! We have a great God who is worthy of all our praise, all our love, and our whole life!

We live in a time where there are many distractions. The prince of this world is truly out to destroy people’s lives at whatever cost. We have amusement parks, video arcades, theaters, internet, Facebook, fashion malls, and whatever else you can think of—it’s out there. But God would have our hearts stirred to not be entangled with these distractions, but rather to work for Him and His Kingdom. If we are entangled with the affairs of this life, we will have no time left for our Lord. We cannot serve two masters. There seem to be some things trying to steal the time of our dear sisters (young and old alike). Let us be aware of these things so that we can be free from them and then be free to serve the Lord with our whole hearts.

The one thing we should be aware of is called adornment and the other is foolishness or looseness. To me it is so amazing how God works. He tells us in His Word what not to adorn ourselves with, but He also tells us what to adorn ourselves with. He tells us what fruit should be coming from our lives, and what fruit should not be coming from our lives. For every evil way that there is, God also shows us the right way. I know many of us would not go to fashion malls to buy our clothes, but I fear that many of us are still looking for clothes that accent the body rather than glorify our Lord. Jesus said: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God –Matthew 5:8.

Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel; But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price. For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement –1 Peter 3:3-6.

Adorn: to deck or beautify; set off; to embellish by anything external or adventitious; to display the beauty or excellence of.

Remember, God wants us to adorn ourselves with things that will bring glory to Him. Depending on the type of clothing that I choose to wear, the focus of others is drawn to my clothing first, instead of my countenance. When this happens then I am getting all the glory because the focus is on my apparel. But if somebody sees me and they can see the clear countenance on my face and they can tell that I’ve been with Jesus, then they will give God all the glory that He deserves, and we will be displaying the beauty or excellence of God’s spirit in our lives.

Now let’s take a look at some more of the words found in our Scripture text and consider their meaning:

Plaiting: folding, doubling, braiding.

Apparel: clothing; external habiliments or decorations.

Ornament: That which embellishes; or something which, added to another thing, renders it most beautiful to the eye.

How beautiful it is to our Lord when we become born again, have a broken spirit, and become meek and quiet. Can people see the fruits of God’s spirit in our lives—as ornaments? Truly that is an ornament of great price. Remember we can add external ornaments to our lives that bring sadness to our Father. Let us not make Him ashamed to call us His sons and daughters.

Meek: mild of temper; soft; gentle; not easily provoked or irritated; yielding, given to forbearance under injuries.

Are we irritated if somebody has something to share with us that will help us in our walk with the Lord? Remember our Lord wants the fruit of meekness adorning our converted lives.

Quiet: still; being in a state of rest; not moving; peaceable; not turbulent; not giving offence; not exciting controversy, disorder, or trouble; mild; meek; contented.

With every new style that comes in among us are we quick to change for no reason other than adding something to our bodies that only brings glory to us? Are we content with the biblical standard of God for our lives? Are we firm and grounded in what we believe? Do we know why we believe in what we believe?

Subjection: the act of subduing; the act of vanquishing and bringing under the dominion of another.

Are we under the dominion of our Lord in every aspect of our lives?

Afraid: impressed with fear or apprehension.

Amazement: astonishment; confusion or perplexity from a sudden impression of fear, surprise, or wonder.

We are daughters of Sarah as long as we do well, and are not impressed with fear or any confusion or perplexity. God is not the author of confusion—The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul… –Psalm 19:7. Remember: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom [not confusion]… –Proverbs 9:10.

Entangleth: to twist or interweave in such a manner as not to be easily separated; to perplex or distract, as with cares.

Are we allowing our lives to be interwoven with the fashions and foolishness of this world?

No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier. But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness. Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart –2 Timothy 2:4-22.

Shun: to avoid; to keep clear of; not to fall on or come in contact with; not to mix or associate with.

Are we shunning the practices of this world? More specifically, are we shunning loose and empty talk?

Profane: irreverent to anything sacred; polluted; not pure.

Vain: empty; worthless; having no substance, value, or importance.

What we fill ourselves with will come out. If we are filling ourselves with God’s holy Word, then that will be flowing out of our lives. However, if we are filling ourselves with vain things then that shall come out as well.

Babblings: foolish talk.

Is our talk centered on the Bible, or is it centered on the new things that we have bought such as a new garment or a vehicle, or maybe it’s on all the people we have met on Facebook?

Flee: to run with rapidity, as from danger; to hasten from danger; or expected evil.

If we are with a group of people whose talk is foolish, do we stay for fear of losing friends or do we walk (or run) away from the expected or dangerous evil? The more we interweave our lives with the ways of the world, the harder it is to untangle ourselves.

Lusts: longing desire; eagerness to possess or enjoy; carnal appetite; unlawful desire of carnal pleasure.

God will give us the true desires of our heart. We may say that we desire pure things, but if our heart is yearning for unlawful things, we shall yield to those things. Our lives consist not only in what we say, but more importantly what we live. Also, take courage, the inward desires of our heart can be forever changed through the spiritual operation or “new birth”.

Righteousness: the active and passive obedience of Christ, by which the law of God is fulfilled.

If we are to follow righteousness, then that means we should follow the active and passive obedience that Christ shows us by his example.

Faith: the object of belief; a doctrine or system of doctrines believed.

What is the reality of our faith? Do we really believe God and what He tells us through His written Word? It was because Abraham believed God that he was able to “offer up” his only son Isaac through whom Abraham’s descendants would be counted. –see Hebrews 11:17 and Genesis 22:13. If God tells us in His Word to shun ungodliness because it will lead to more ungodliness, then we need to believe God and flee those things, and we must not allow ourselves to think that just a little bit of fun will not matter.

Charity: love; benevolence; goodwill; that disposition of the heart which inclines men to think favorably of their fellow men, and to do them good; it includes supreme love to God our Maker and universal good will to men.

Do we have the Love of God dwelling within and flowing out of our lives like a spring of running water?

Peace: heavenly rest; harmony; freedom from disturbance or agitation.

We are to follow the example of our dear Savior Jesus Christ whose whole life was in perfect harmony with God the Father. Christ was not disturbed or disrupted by the ways of this world, but He was at rest doing His Father’s will. Are we?

Pure: clear; free from moral defilement; without spot; holy; incorrupt.

We are to follow or have these fruits adorned in our lives and also practicing these with those who are practicing the same things in their own lives. A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array; But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works –1 Timothy 2:9-10.

Shamefacedness: bashfulness; excess of modesty.

We should be adorned with shamefacedness and not giddiness or sensuality.

Sobriety: habitual soberness; seriousness; gravity without sadness or melancholy.

Even if we are sober we don’t need to be sad but we can have the joy of the Lord adorning our lives. There should be a light in our eyes because Jesus is the light of our lives. Truly if God’s spirit is dwelling within us we have so much to be thankful for. It should be evident in every aspect of our lives.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men, Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world –Titus 2:11-12.

I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels –Isaiah 61:10.

The ornaments of modesty, shamefacedness, sobriety, faith, charity, peace, righteousness, meekness, and quietness are truly jewels of great price. These jewels are so valuable that it is worth surrendering our whole lives to the God of Heaven, our Maker, and our Redeemer, so that we may have them adorning our lives. But likewise, if we are surrendered to the god of this world we will have the ornaments of pride, envy, hate, jealousy, and so forth. Which ones are the more beautiful?

And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband. And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God. –Revelation 21:2-3.

Are we preparing to meet Jesus? Is God dwelling in us? Is He our God and are we His people?

Remember time is swiftly passing by. We can be here today and gone tomorrow. Do we want to be with Jesus throughout all eternity, or do we want to be with the devil and his angels? The choices we make for our lives today will affect where we spend eternity.

Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap –Galatians 6:7. Don’t be misled. That verse is also for the believer, not just for the unconverted. Each one of us can ask ourselves what we are sowing. Concerning adornment, are we sowing the thought that outward beauty is very important or are we sowing the thought that inward beauty is the most precious thing to have and obtain? For clarification, I am not talking about being dirty and unkempt. God is a God of order and cleanliness, but He is not a God of ribbons, bows, frills, lace, and expensive, attractive clothing. Remember that most people who create new clothing fashions focus on designing garments so that they will be appealing and attractive to the eye. That is what makes people buy them.

Again, when people look at us do they glorify our fleshly body or are they praising God for the work that He is doing in our lives? Also, concerning foolishness and looseness, if we are grounded in the word of God, we will not have time for vain babblings and pleasure-seeking idleness. Let us be busy doing the work of our Lord, such as helping our neighbor who could use an extra hand, or sharing our testimony with people that we meet.

And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell –Matthew 10:28. As we live in these last times, the message that is all around us is that as long as you believe in a God, you will be okay. That is a false message. Jesus tells us there is only one way. Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him –John 14:6-7. Praise the Lord that God has given us an example to follow.

ইশুর নামে ভালবাসার শুভেচ্ছা! আমাদের এক মহান ঈশ্বর আছেন, যিনি আমাদের সমস্ত প্রসংসা, সমস্ত ভালবাসা এবং আমাদের সমগ্র জীবন পাওয়ার যোগ্য!

আমরা এমন এক যুগে বাস করছি যেখানে অসংখ্য বিভ্রান্তি আছে। এই জগতের রেচসপতি সত্যই মানুষের জীবন ধ্বংস করতে যেকোনো মূল্যে চেষ্টা করছে। আমাদের কাছে বিনোদন পার্ক, ভিডিও আর্কেড, থিয়েটার, ইন্টারনেট, ফেসবুক, ফ্যাশন মল ও আপনি যা খুশি ভাবতে পারেন—সবই আছে। কিন্তু ঈশ্বর আমাদের হৃদয়গুলি এই বিভ্রান্তিগুলোর সঙ্গে জড়িয়ে পড়ে না এমনভাবে উত্থিত হতে চান, বরং আমাদেরকে তাঁর ও তাঁর রাজ্যের জন্য কাজ করতে চান। যদি আমরা জীবনের অ-বিষয়গুলোর মধ্যে জড়ানো থাকি, তবে আমাদের প্রভুর জন্য কোনও সময় থাকবে না। আমরা দুইজন প্রভুকে সেবা করতে পারি না। মনে হয় কিছু জিনিস আমাদের প্রিয় বোনদের (যুবতী তথা বয়স্ক সকলেই) সময় চুরি করার চেষ্টা করছে। আসুন আমরা এসব বিষয়ে সচেতন হই যাতে আমরা সেগুলো থেকে মুক্ত হতে পারি এবং তারপর আমাদের সকল হৃদয় দিয়ে প্রভুকে সেবা করতে মুক্ত হতে পারি।

একটি জিনিস যার সম্পর্কে আমাদের সচেতন থাকা উচিত তা হলো সজ্জা এবং অন্যটি হলো বোকামি বা ঢিলেঢালা আচরণ। আমার কাছে বিস্ময়কর কীভাবে ঈশ্বর কাজ করেন। তিনি আমাদের নিজের বাক্যে বলেন কোনো কিছুর সঙ্গে সজ্জিত না হওয়া—কিন্তু তিনি এও বলেন যে কিসের সঙ্গে সজ্জিত হওয়া উচিত। তিনি আমাদের বলে দেন কেমন ফল আমাদের জীবন থেকে বেরোয়া উচিত, এবং কেমন ফল বেরোয়া উচিত নয়। প্রতিটি দুষ্কর্মের পথ থাকা সত্ত্বেও ঈশ্বর আমাদের সঠিক পথও দেখান। আমি জানি আমাদের অনেকেই হয়তো ফ্যাশন মলে কাপড় কিনতে যাব না, কিন্তু আমি আশঙ্কা করি যে আমাদের অনেকেই এখনও এমন কাপড় খুঁজছি যা দেহকে জোরে তুলে ধরে বরং আমাদের প্রভুকে মহিমা করে না। যিশু বলেছিলেন: ধন্য হয়ন তারা যারা হৃদয় শুদ্ধ: তারা ঈশ্বরকে দেখিবে—মথি ৫:৮।

যাদের সজ্জা বাইরের সজ্জা যেন না হয়—চুল বিঁধা, স্বর্ণ পরিধান, বা পোশাক পরিধান করা; বরং অন্তরীণ মানুষটি হোক, দুর্জন না হওয়া, নরম ও শান্ত আত্মার সজ্জা, যাহা ঈশ্বরের দৃষ্টিতে অতি মূল্যবান। কারণ প্রাচীন কালেও খ্রিষ্টবিশ্বাসী নারীরা ঈশ্বরকে ভরসা করে নিজেদের এইরূপে সজ্জিত করিত যে, তাঁরা নিজেদের স্বামীগণের প্রতি শ্রেষ্ঠ কর্তৃত্বে অটল ছিল; যেমন সারা আব্রাহামকে বিধবা বলেন এবং তাঁকে প্রভু বলে ডাকা ছিল: আপনারা তেমনদের কন্যাসন্তান, যদি আপনাগণ ভাল করিয়া থাকেন এবং কোন বিস্ময়বোধে ভয় না পান—১ পিতর ৩:৩-৬।

Adorn: সজ্জিত করা বা সুশোভিত করা; বাহ্যিক বা আকস্মিক কোনো কিছুর দ্বারা সজ্জিত করা; সৌন্দর্য বা উৎকৃষ্টতা প্রদর্শন করা।

মনে রাখবেন, ঈশ্বর চান আমরা এমন জিনিস দিয়ে নিজেদের সজ্জিত করি যা তাঁর মহিমা আনবে। আমি পরিধান করার জন্য যে ধরনের পোশাক বেছে নিই তার উপর নির্ভর করে, অন্যদের দৃষ্টি প্রথমত আমার পোশাকের দিকে আকর্ষিত হয়, আমার চেহারার দিকে নয়। যখন এভাবে হয় তখন আমারাই সমস্ত মহিমা পাচ্ছি কারণ দৃষ্টি আমার পোশাকের উপর। কিন্তু যদি কারো আমাকে দেখে এবং তিনি আমার মুখে স্পষ্ট ছাপ দেখতে পান এবং বলতে পারেন যে আমি যিশুর সান্নিধ্য পেয়েছি, তখন তারা ঈশ্বরকে সমুদয় মহিমা দেবে এবং আমরা আমাদের জীবনে ঈশ্বরের আত্মার সৌন্দর্য বা উৎকৃষ্টতা প্রদর্শন করব।

এখন আসুন আমরা আমাদের শাস্ত্রগত পাঠ্যে পাওয়া কিছু শব্দের দিকে আরও তাকাই এবং তাদের অর্থ বিবেচনা করি:

Plaiting: ভাঁজ করা, দ্বিগুণ করা, চুল বোনা বা বরিৎ করা।

Apparel: পরিধান; বাহ্যিক পোশাক বা সজ্জা।

Ornament: যা প্রসাধিত করে; কোনো কিছুর সঙ্গে যুক্ত হলে যা চকুতেও সর্বাধিক সুন্দর করে তোলে।

কী সৌন্দর্য যখন আমরা পুনর্জন্ম লাভ করি, মন ভাঙা পাই, এবং নম্র ও শান্ত হয়ে উঠি। মানুষ কি আমাদের জীবনে ঈশ্বরের আত্মার ফলগুলো—অলঙ্কারের মতো—দেখতে পারে? সত্যিই তা একটি মূল্যবান অলঙ্কার। মনে রাখবেন আমরা এমন বাহ্যিক অলঙ্কারও যোগ করতে পারি যা আমাদের পিতাকে দুঃখী করে। আসুন আমরা তাঁকে লজ্জিত না করি যে তিনি আমাদেরকে তাঁর পুত্র ও কন্যা বলতে পারেন।

Meek: স্বভাবত নম্র; কোমল; শান্ত; সহজে উত্তেজিত বা বিরক্ত না হওয়া; সহনশীলতা প্রদর্শন করা।

আমরা কি বিরক্ত হই যদি কেউ আমাদের সঙ্গে এমন কিছু শেয়ার করে যা আমাদের প্রভুর সঙ্গে আমাদের চলায় সাহায্য করবে? মনে রাখবেন আমাদের প্রভু চান যে নম্রতার ফল আমাদের রুপান্তরিত জীবনে সজ্জা হোক।

Quiet: স্থির; বিশ্রামের অবস্থায় থাকা; না-সঞ্চলিত; শান্তিপূর্ণ; না-উত্তেজক; কেয়ামত না করা; বিতর্ক, বিশৃঙ্খলা বা সমস্যার কারণ না হওয়া; নম্র; ক্ষান্ত; পরিতৃপ্ত।

প্রতিটি নতুন ফ্যাশন আমাদের কাছে আসার সাথে কি আমরা দ্রুত বদলাতে থাকি কোনো কারণ ছাড়াই, শুধুমাত্র আমাদের দেহে এমন কিছু যোগ করার জন্য যা কেবল আমাদেরই মহিমা বাড়ায়? আমরা কি ঈশ্বরের বংশীয় মানদণ্ডে সন্তুষ্ট? আমরা কি যে কিছু বিশ্বাস করি তাতে দৃঢ় এবং প্রতিষ্ঠিত? আমরা কি জানি কেন আমরা যা বিশ্বাস করি তা বিশ্বাস করি?

Subjection: অধীনতা অর্জনের কাজ; পরাজয়ের কাজ ও অন্যের অধীনতায় আনা।

আমরা কি আমাদের জীবনের প্রতিদিকেই প্রভুর অধীনে আছি?

Afraid: ভয়ের বা অনির্ভরতার ছাপপ্রাপ্ত।

Amazement: বিস্ময়; হঠাৎ ভয়, বিস্ময় বা আশ্চর্যের প্রভাবে সৃষ্ট বিভ্রান্তি বা হতবুদ্ধি।

আমরা সারার কন্যাসন্তান যতক্ষণ ভাল করিয়া থাকি ততক্ষণ—as long as আমরা ভয় বা কোনো বিভ্রান্তিতে প্রভাবিত না হই। ঈশ্বর বিভ্রান্তির স্রষ্টা নন—প্রভুর আইন পূর্ণ, আত্মাকে ফেরত আনে…—য়া৩বিশ ১৯:৭। মনে রাখবেন: প্রভুর ভয় জ্ঞানের আরম্ভ [বিভ্রান্তি নয়] …—প্রবচন ৯:১০।

Entangleth: এমনভাবে টান করা বা আন্তঃবোনা যাতে সহজে ছিন্ন করা যায় না; যত্ন দ্বারা বিভ্রান্ত বা বিঘ্নিত করা।

আমরা কি আমাদের জীবন ফ্যাশন এবং এই জগতের বোকামির সঙ্গে আন্তঃবোনা হতে দিচ্ছি?

যে যুদ্ধ করে, সে নিজেকে জীবনের এই বিবাদ নিয়ে জড়ায় না; যাতে তিনি যাকে সৈনিক হওয়ার জন্য তাঁকে নির্বাচিত করেছেন তাঁর পছন্দ করিতে পারেন। কিন্তু দাঙ্গাময় ও বেকার বাক্যত্যাগ এড়াও; কারণ এগুলা অধিক অধরময়তায় বৃদ্ধি পাবে। যৌবনের কামনা থেকাও বাঁচ; কিন্তু ধার্মিকতা, বিশ্বাস, প্রেম, শান্তি, নিষ্কুপিত প্রাণে প্রভুকে ডাকেন তাদের সঙ্গে মিলিয়া চল—২ তিমوتিয় ২:৪-২২।

Shun: এড়ানো; পরিষ্কার দূরে রাখা; সংস্পর্শে না আসা; মিশা বা সংযুক্ত না হওয়া।

আমরা কি এই জগতের আচরণগুলো এড়াচ্ছি? আরও বিশেষ করে, আমরা কি ঢিলা ও ফাঁকা কথা এড়াচ্ছি?

Profane: পবিত্রের প্রতি অবিবেচক; দূষিত; বিশুদ্ধ নয়।

Vain: শূন্য; মূল্যহীন; কোনো উপাদান, মূল্য বা গুরুত্ব নেই।

আমরা যা নিজেদের সঙ্গে ভরাই তা বেরিয়েই আসবে। যদি আমরা নিজেদেরকে ঈশ্বরের পবিত্র বাক্য দিয়ে ভরাই, তবে তা আমাদের জীবনে প্রবাহিত হবে। তবে যদি আমরা নিজেদেরকে শূন্য জিনিসে ভরাই, তবে সেটাও বেরিয়ে আসবে।

Babblings: বোকা কথাবার্তা।

আমাদের কথা বাইবেলের উপর কেন্দ্রিত কি, না কি তা নতুন কিছুর উপর—যেমন নতুন কাপড় বা কোনো যানবাহন, বা হতে পারে ফেসবুকে আমরা যেসব মানুষের সঙ্গে মিলেছি তাদের সব সম্পর্কে?

Flee: দ্রুততা সহ পালানো, যেন বিপদ হতে; বিপদ বা প্রত্যাশিত দুষ্টতায় থেকে তাড়াতাড়ি সরে আসা।

যদি আমরা এমন একটি মানুষের দলে থাকি যার কথা বোকা, আমরা কি বন্ধু হারানোর ভয়ে থাকি, না কি প্রত্যাশিত বা বিপজ্জনক দুষ্টতা থেকে চলি (বা ছুটে পালাই)? যত বেশি আমরা আমাদের জীবন জগতের পথে আন্তঃবোনা করব, তত কঠিন হবে নিজেদেরকে বিচ্ছিন্ন করা।

Lusts: প্রবল আকাঙ্ক্ষা; অধিগ্রহণ বা ভোগের তাড়না; কামুক খাবারের বাসনা; মাংসাত্মক আনন্দের অবৈধ বাসনা।

ঈশ্বর আমাদের হৃদয়ের সত্যিকারের ইচ্ছা দিবেন। আমরা বলতে পারি যে আমরা পবিত্র জিনিস চাই, কিন্তু যদি আমাদের অন্তর অবৈধ জিনিসের জন্য আকুল হয়, আমরা সেই জিনিসগুলোর কাছে হেরে যাব। আমাদের জীবন কেবল যা আমরা বলি তা নয়, বরং আরও গুরুত্বপূর্ণ হল আমরা কিভাবে জীবন যাপন করি। তদুপরি সাহস উদ্ধার করো—অন্তরের ইচ্ছা চিরতরে পরিবর্তিত হতে পারে আধ্যাত্মিক কার্যক্রম বা “নতুন জন্ম” এর মাধ্যমে।

Righteousness: খ্রিস্টের সক্রিয় ও নিষ্ক্রিয় আনুগত্য, যার দ্বারা ঈশ্বরের আইন পূর্ণ হয়।

যদি আমাদের ধার্মিকতার অনুসরণ করতে হয়, তবেই এর অর্থ আমরা খ্রিষ্টের উদাহরণ দিয়ে প্রদর্শিত সক্রিয় ও নিষ্ক্রিয় আনুগত্য অনুসরণ করব।

Faith: বিশ্বাসের বস্তু; যে ধর্মশাস্ত্র বা ধর্মশাস্ত্রের ব্যবস্থা বিশ্বাস করা হয়।

আমাদের বিশ্বাসের বাস্তবতা কী? আমরা কি সত্যি ঈশ্বরকে এবং তিনি যা আমাদের লিখিত বাক্যের মাধ্যমে বলেন তা বিশ্বাস করি? আব্রাহাম ঈশ্বরকে বিশ্বাস করায় তিনি তাঁর একমাত্র ছেলে ইসাহাককে “অর্পণ” করতে সক্ষম হন যার মধ্য দিয়ে আব্রাহামের উত্তরাধিকার গণ্য হতো। —দেখুন হিব্রু ১১:১৭ ও উদ্ভাবনী ২২:১৩। যদি ঈশ্বর আমাদের বাক্যে বলে অনৈতিকতা এড়াও কারণ তা অধিক অনৈতিকতার দিকে নিয়ে যাবে, তবে আমাদের ঈশ্বরকে বিশ্বাস করে সেই সমস্ত বিষয় থেকে পালাতে হবে, এবং আমাদের নিজেকে ভাবতে দেবেন না যে সামান্য মজাও কোনো ব্যাপার করবে না।

Charity: প্রেম; মঙ্গলকামনা; সদাশয়তা; হৃদয়ের সেই প্রবণতা যা মানুষকে অন্য মানুষের প্রতি অনুকুলভাবে ভাবতে এবং তাদের কল্যাণ করতে পরিচালিত করে; এতে সৃষ্টিকর্তা ঈশ্বরের প্রতি সর্বোচ্চ প্রেম ও মানুষের প্রতি সার্বজনীন মঙ্গলকামনা অন্তর্ভুক্ত।

প্রভুর প্রেম কি আমাদের মাঝে বাস করে এবং আমাদের জীবনের বাইরে একটি ঝর্ণার মত প্রবাহিত হচ্ছে?

Peace: পার্থিব বিশ্রাম; ঐক্য; বিঘ্ন বা উত্তেজনা থেকে মুক্তি।

আমরা আমাদের প্রিয় ত্রাণকর্তা যীশু খ্রিষ্টের উদাহরণ অনুসরণ করব যার পুরো জীবন পিতার সঙ্গে পরিপূর্ণ ঐক্যে ছিল। খ্রিস্ট এই জগতের উপায়ে বিঘ্নিত বা ব্যাহত হননি, বরং তিনি বিশ্রামে ছিলেন পিতার ইচ্ছা পালন করে। আমরা কি তাই?

Pure: স্পষ্ট; নৈতিক দাগ থেকে মুক্ত; বিন্দুমাত্র মিল নেই; পবিত্র; অনাময়।

আমরা এই ফলগুলোকে আমাদের জীবনে সজ্জিত হিসাবে অনুসরণ বা ধারণ করব এবং সেইসব লোকদের সঙ্গে তাদের অনুশীলন করব যারা নিজেদের জীবনে একই বিষয়গুলো অনুশীলন করছে। সামান্য খমির পুরো গুঁড়োকে ফুলায়।

ইত্যাদি রীতিতে নারীরা নিজেকে বিনীত পোশাক-শৈলীতে সজ্জা করুক, লজ্জাবোধ ও সংযমে; না হোক জট করা চুল, স্বর্ণ, মুক্তাশ্রীকোল বা দামী সাজসজ্জা; বরং (যা ধার্মিকতা প্রকাশ করে এমন নারীদের অনুলক্ষ্য) সদা কর্তব্যকর্তা কর্মে—১ তিমথিয় ২:৯-১০।

Shamefacedness: লজ্জাশীলতা; অতিরিক্ত নম্রতা।

আমরা লজ্জাশীলতা দিয়ে সজ্জিত হওয়া উচিত, হঠকারীতা বা কামুকতায় নয়।

Sobriety: অভ্যস্ত সংযম; গুরুত্ব; বিষণ্ণতা বা বিমর্ষতা ছাড়া গুরুতরতা।

এমনকি যদি আমরা সংযত হই, তবে আমাদের দুঃখী থাকার দরকার নেই, বরং আমরা প্রভুর আনন্দ দ্বারা সজ্জিত থাকতে পারি। আমাদের চোখে একটি আলোক থাকা উচিত কারণ যিশু আমাদের জীবনের আলোক। সত্যিই যদি ঈশ্বরের আত্মা আমাদের মধ্যে বাস করে, তাহলে আমাদের কৃতজ্ঞ হওয়ার অনেক কিছু আছে। এটা আমাদের জীবনের প্রতিটি দিকেই স্পষ্ট হওয়া উচিত।

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

ঈশ্বরের অনুগ্রহ, যে সকলের জন্য ত্রাণ এনেছে, সকল মানুষের কাছে প্রদর্শিত হইয়াছে; আমাদের শিক্ষা দিয়া যে অনৈক্য ও পার্থিব আশা ত্যাগ করে আমরা এই বর্তমান জগতেতে সংযত, ধার্মিক এবং ভগবৎসুলভ জীবন যাপন করিব—তীতুস ২:১১-১২।

আমি প্রভুর মধ্যে বড়ভাবে আনন্দ করিব; আমার আত্মা আমার ঈশ্বরের মধ্যে আনন্দিত হইবে; কারণ তিনি আমাকে ত্রাণের বস্ত্র পরিধান করিয়াছেন, আমাকে ধার্মিকতার লেবশ দ্বারা আবৃত করিয়াছেন, যেমন যে বর তাঁর অলংকরণে সাজে, এবং যেমনি কনে নিজের রত্ন-আলঙ্কার দ্বারা নিজেকে সজ্জায়—ইসাইয়াহ ৬১:১০।

শরীরিক লজ্জা, লজ্জাশীলতা, সংযম, বিশ্বাস, প্রেম, শান্তি, ধার্মিকতা, নম্রতা এবং ক্ষান্ততা—এই অলংকারগুলো সত্যিই অতি মূল্যবান রত্ন। এই রত্নগুলো এত মূল্যবান যে স্বর্গের ঈশ্বর, আমাদের স্রষ্টা ও উদ্ধারকর্তার কাছে আমাদের সার্বিক জীবন সমর্পণ করাও মূল্যবান, যাতে আমাদের জীবনে এগুলো সজ্জা হিসেবে থাকুক। কিন্তু তেমনি, যদি আমরা এই বিশ্বের দেবতার কাছে আত্মসমর্পিত তবেই আমাদের মাথার অলংকার হবে অহংকার, রূঢ়তা, ঘৃণা, ঈর্ষা ইত্যাদি। কোনগুলো বেশি সুন্দর?

আর আমি যোহন জাহিল নগরী পবিত্র দেখিলাম, নতুন যেরুসালেম, যাহা ঈশ্বরের পক্ষ হইতে স্বর্গ থেকে নেমে আসিতেছে, সদা পতি-ভূত কনেরূপে সাজিয়া প্রস্তুত। আর আমি স্বর্গ হইতে একটি বৃহৎ গলিতে শুনিলাম, যতক্ষণ দিখাও, ঈশ্বরের তাবু-আশ্রয় মানুষের মধ্য আছে, এবং তিনি ত তাদের সঙ্গে বাস করিবেন, এবং তাঁরা হইবেন তাঁর লোক, এবং ঈশ্বর নিজে তদের সঙ্গে হইবেন, এবং ত উহারাই তদের ঈশ্বর হইবেন—প্রকাশ ২১:২-৩।

আমরা কি যিশুকে মিলনের জন্য প্রস্তুতি নিচ্ছি? ঈশ্বর কি আমাদের মধ্যে বাস করিতেছেন? তিনি কি আমাদের ঈশ্বর এবং আমরা কি তাঁর লোক?

মনে রাখবেন সময় দ্রুত অতিবাহিত হচ্ছে। আমরা আজ এখানে থাকতে পারি এবং আগামীকাল চলে যেতে পারি। আমরা কি চিরকাল ধরে যিশুর সঙ্গে থাকতে চাই, না কি শয়তান ও তাঁর ফেরেশতাদের সঙ্গে থাকতে চাই? আজ আমরা যেসব সিদ্ধান্ত নেব তা আমাদের চিরন্তন অবস্থান প্রভাবিত করবে।

ভ্রান্ত হইও না; ঈশ্বর আপনি ব্যঙ্গ করা যায় না: কারণ কোন ব্যক্তি যে দান করবে, তদূরূপই সে কেবল ধান্য পাবে—গলাতীয় ৬:৭। ভুলে যেও না। সেই শ্লোক বিশ্বাসীকেও উদ্দেশ্য করে, কেবল অনুপুষ্টদের জন্য নয়। আমাদের প্রত্যেকেই নিজেকে জিজ্ঞাসা করতে পারি আমরা কী বপন করছি। সজ্জা সম্পর্কে, আমরা কি বপন করছি যে বাহ্যিক সৌন্দর্য খুবই গুরুত্বপূর্ণ, না কি আমরা বপন করছি যে অন্তরের সৌন্দর্য সবচেয়ে মূল্যবান জিনিস? স্পষ্টতার জন্য বলছি, আমি নোংরা ও অনুচ্ছন্ন হওয়ার কথা বলছি না। ঈশ্বর নির্দেশ ও শুদ্ধতার ঈশ্বর, কিন্তু তিনি রিবন, বঁটা, ঝুলনা, লেইস, এবং ব্যয়বহুল আকর্ষণীয় পোশাকের ঈশ্বর নন। মনে রাখবেন যে নতুন পোশাক শৈলী তৈরি করা মানুষরা সাধারণত এমন পোশাক ডিজাইন করে যাতে তা চক্ষুকে আকর্ষণীয় ও আবেদনযোগ্য করে তোলে। সেটাই মানুষকে কিনতে বাধ্য করে।

আবার, যখন মানুষ আমাদের দিকে তাকায় তারা কি আমাদের করিডোর শরীরকে মহিমা করে, না কি তারা ঈশ্বরকে প্রশংসা করে আমাদের জীবনে তিনি যে কাজ করছেন তার কারণে? আরও, বোকামি ও ঢিলেঢালাফerah সম্পর্কে—যদি আমরা ঈশ্বরের বাক্যতে প্রতিষ্ঠিত থাকি, আমরা ফাঁকা কথা ও আনন্দ-অন্বেষণী অলসতার জন্য সময় পাব না। আসুন আমরা প্রভুর কাজে ব্যস্ত থাকি, যেমন আমাদের প্রতিবেশী যাঁকে অতিরিক্ত সাহায্য দরকার, তাকে সহায়তা করা, অথবা আমরা যে মানুষদের সঙ্গে মিলিত হই তাদের সঙ্গে আমাদের সাক্ষাৎকার ভাগ করা।

আর যারা দেহকে হত্যা করে, তাগলি-দর, তাদের ভয় করিও না; বরং তাঁকে ভয় কর যে আত্মা ও দেহ দুইটাকেই নরকেতে ধ্বংস করতে সক্ষম—মথি ১০:২৮। এই শেষ সময়ে আমরা যখন বাস করি, আমাদের চারিপাশের বার্তা হলো যতক্ষণ তুমি একটি ঈশ্বরে বিশ্বাস করো ততক্ষণ তুমি ঠিক থাকবে। এটি একটি মিথ্যা বার্তা। যিশু বলে একমাত্র পথ আছে। যীশু তাঁকে বলিলেন, আমি পথ, সত্য ও জীবন: কোন ব্যক্তি পিতার কাছে আমার দ্বারা ব্যতীত আসিতে পারে না। যদি তোমরা আমাকে জানিতে পারিত, তুমি আমার পিতাকেও জানিত; এবং এখান থেকে তুমি তাঁকে জানো এবং দেখিয়াছো—যোহন ১৪:৬-৭। প্রভুকে ধন্যবাদ যে ঈশ্বর আমাদের অনুসরণের জন্য একটি উদাহরণ দিয়েছেন।

I have enjoyed listening to, and even taking part in, discussions about the Covid shot—about why someone has, and why the other has not, received it. I venture to say we could have seven people give their viewpoint on the subject and maybe have eight different ideas.

I begin with the disclaimer that these are my thoughts, and I am quite okay with someone disagreeing. In fact, I would welcome others to share their viewpoints.

One of the things you will notice in this writing is that I don’t call the Covid shot a ‘vaccine’. Not that it doesn’t technically fit the official definition, but rather that it doesn’t function the way we have known vaccines to work. I remember when I was a lad about four years of age, I went with my mother to the health department and received a vaccination in my upper arm for smallpox. (The pock mark is still there) I remember some years later when the whole community gathered at our local public school for the sugar cube treatment which was an oral vaccination against polio. I don’t remember if I had any other vaccinations or not. My point is that these vaccinations were immunizations against a disease. We were assured that we would not get smallpox, polio, measles or whatever else we were vaccinated for. And we didn’t—not just a lesser amount or a case not as severe. We understood that we were immunized, and the fight was over.

During the current pandemic we kept hearing about the vaccination that was coming. It sounded like this was going to be the answer to this pestilence that had settled on the world. Some of us wondered if this would be like the flu shot that targets certain viruses, while it misses the other flu viruses. As the drama unfolded, we soon began to hear of variants and the need for booster shots. We now know for sure that this shot does not give an immunization for Covid 19, and hence, for clarity it is better to call it a flu shot.

I remember so well farming in the early 90’s and hearing about Roundup-Ready crops. It seemed too good to be true to be able to spray glyphosate (Roundup) over the top of the crop and take out all the weeds while doing no harm to the crop. The manufacturer did keep telling us to spray maximum rates so as to ‘kill’ every weed. Theoretically they were right, if we could have killed every weed, without missing one, we would not have had the next problem—spray-resistant weeds. We didn’t realize how fast our troublesome ‘pigweeds’ (and other weeds) in the south, would mutate and develop a resistance to glyphosate.

Sure, farmers had several good years with an easy way to keep out the weeds, but that didn’t last and now the situation is worse than it was before. Today, every farmer knows about ‘Palmer amaranth Pigweed’. You can almost ‘pour’ glyphosate on it, and still it thrives. These weeds mutated very rapidly and became resistant.

I think we have a similar scenario with the Covid shot. I’m certainly not a scientist but it does seem to me that since the shot admittedly mostly reduces symptoms instead of producing immunity, then it will most likely speed up the mutation of the Covid-19 virus. This seems like the normal ‘struggle for survival’ principle of life.

The rapid speed with which this shot came on the market is another concern. We really don’t know what all it will bring down the road nor the side effects it may cause. We don’t know how many boosters will be called for. It seems the world is the test field at the moment, and from what I’m seeing it is not working too well and many of the people who have had the shot don’t really trust it. The people who have had the virus have built an immunity that is far superior to the protection of the shot. We’ve known since childhood that when we had the flu, our body would build immunity to that strain. This is the way our Maker designed us. One of the first people I personally knew that had Covid was told they would have six months of immunity. I wondered how they figured that out so quickly. This was a new virus, and we had no experience to draw on for this virus. Also, the viruses we were familiar with gave lifetime immunity to that strain. So what science was behind this?

Hence, I think it much better to take precautions and do what we can to boost our immune system. It is an excellent time to remember we are to be stewards of the body that God gave us. It’s a good time to put a plan in place of good nutrition, exercise, and weight loss. If you are overweight, you are much more likely to be affected by this pestilence and many other illnesses. If you regularly consume sugary drinks or unhealthy foods of any kind, it is an excellent time to kick the habit and reduce your sugar consumption. If you are overweight or out of shape physically, there is no better time than now to bring your body into a condition that will be much healthier, so you will be better able to ward off this virus and many other illnesses.

My belief is that in the long run it will be safer and better to do my part and let this body build the immunities to protect itself against this virus. I realize there are those who have died after contracting this illness. I don’t belittle this fact and I am sorry for the loss of life. I do believe too that we as Christians should constantly commit our lives to God and look at the whole picture of life and its preservation through the lens of Christian ethics.

It is unprecedented that an illness with a recovery rate of somewhere around 99%, would cause such a stir, the world over. We know that if it wouldn’t be for the invention of social media there would not have been near the panic and turmoil. One of my greatest concerns is how we are being ‘conditioned’ for more to come. Who would have ever thought that a flu virus would be the instrument that ushers in a global push for something that will be the benchmark for whether we can travel, go to eating places, gather for public events and other such restrictions. It sounds strangely similar to what God says will one day be a reality—And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name –Revelation 13:16-17.

I have been almost ridiculed for even mentioning the mark of the beast. Still others think this passage is to be spiritualized and has nothing to do with the end time system of government. Still others think the bride will be raptured before this, hence nothing for us to be concerned with. I could wish one of these views would be right, then I could move along in silence hoping that all would be well.

I will hasten to say that I don’t think this is the ‘mark of the beast’, but rather I see it as another step closer to that event. I also hasten to say that this is not a writing to ridicule another belief nor is it an effort to try to pull together certain Scriptures to try to support a particular doctrinal agenda such as the idea that all believers will be raptured prior to the unfolding of end time events, thereby escaping what the Bible refers to as “great tribulation”. –See Matthew 24:21 and Revelation 7:14. It’s time we open our eyes to the ‘conditioning’ that our society is having upon us in general, and the conditioning of this shot in particular. There are all kinds of good reasons we will go ahead with it—it makes good sense, it defies science not to, I’ve even heard we can be better witnesses if we have had it, and the list goes on. All the while we are being ‘conditioned’ to do what it takes to keep rolling down our economic road.

So, my plea is that we consider where we are headed. One day God’s people will need to jump off the train of this world—Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you –2 Corinthians 6:17. Revelation 14:10-11 declares that all who take the mark will seal their destiny in hell. The next verse gives a calling for the endurance of the saints—Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus –Revelation 14:12.

There will be hard times—Read Matthew 24:4-28. Consider the famines, pestilences, and earthquakes that are promised will come. Jesus said all these are the beginnings of sorrows—literally birth pangs. He said along with this, ‘the end is not yet’. Yet we have the promise of triumph—And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death –Revelation 12:11. I say again, “One day the saints will need to jump off the economic train.”

I think now is an excellent time to evaluate our attachment, whether it is connected to this world or to our future heavenly reward. Let’s make a commitment anew to identify with our soon coming Lord and King. Also, it’s an excellent time to share the gospel of Jesus’ Kingdom with a society that is bent on going away from the Creator.

So, for now, I’m content to feel safe with the immunity in my body as God created it and I am purposing in a new way to seek the immunity from the ways of sin and evil and to be inoculated with the Holy Ghost from heaven. Will you join me in this commitment?

저는 코로나 주사에 관해 누가 왜 맞았고 누가 왜 맞지 않았는지에 대한 논의를 듣는 것을 즐겼고 때로는 그런 토론에 참여하기도 했습니다. 일곱 사람에게 각자의 견해를 물어보면 아마도 여덟 가지 다른 생각이 나올 것이라고 감히 말하겠습니다.

먼저 고지하는 것은 이 글은 제 개인적인 생각이라는 점이며 다른 사람이 동의하지 않아도 괜찮다는 것입니다. 사실 저는 다른 사람들이 자신의 견해를 나눠주기를 환영합니다.

이 글에서 눈치채실 한 가지는 제가 코로나 주사를 ‘백신’이라고 부르지 않는다는 점입니다. 공식적인 정의상 기술적으로 맞을지 모르지만, 우리가 알고 있던 백신이 작동하는 방식으로는 기능하지 않기 때문입니다. 제가 네 살쯤 되었을 때 어머니를 따라 보건소에 가서 팔 윗부분에 천연두 예방접종을 받았던 일이 기억납니다. (그 자국은 아직도 남아 있습니다.) 몇 년 후에는 우리 지역 공립학교에 온 마을 사람들이 모여 폴리오에 대한 구강 접종인 설탕덩어리 치료를 받던 것도 기억합니다. 다른 예방접종을 더 받았는지는 기억나지 않습니다. 제 요점은 이러한 예방접종들이 질병에 대한 면역을 위한 것이었다는 것입니다. 우리는 천연두, 소아마비, 홍역 등 예방접종을 받은 질병에 걸리지 않을 것이라는 확신을 받았고 실제로도 걸리지 않았습니다—단지 증상이 덜하거나 경증으로 끝난 것이 아니라 확실히 면역된 것으로 이해했고, 그렇게 싸움은 끝난 것이었습니다.

이번 팬데믹 동안 우리는 곧 도착할 예방접종에 대해 계속 들었습니다. 이것이 온 세상을 뒤덮은 재앙에 대한 해답이 될 것처럼 들렸습니다. 어떤 이들은 이것이 특정 바이러스를 표적으로 삼지만 다른 인플루엔자 바이러스는 놓치는 독감 주사와 같을지 궁금해했습니다. 사태가 전개되면서 곧 변이와 추가 접종의 필요성에 대해 듣기 시작했습니다. 이제 우리는 이 주사가 코비드19에 대해 면역을 주지 않는다는 것을 확실히 알게 되었고, 따라서 명확히 하기 위해 이것을 독감 주사라고 부르는 편이 낫습니다.

저는 90년대 초 농사를 짓던 시절 라운드업 레디 작물에 대해 듣던 일이 생생합니다. 작물 위에 글리포세이트(라운드업)를 뿌려 전체 잡초를 제거하면서도 작물에는 해가 가지 않는다는 것이 너무 좋아 보여 믿기 어려웠습니다. 제조사는 항상 '모든' 잡초를 죽이기 위해 최대 농도로 뿌리라고 계속 말했습니다. 이론적으로 그들이 옳았던 것은, 하나도 놓치지 않고 모든 잡초를 죽일 수 있었다면 다음 문제가 생기지 않았을 것이라는 점입니다—즉 스프레이에 저항하는 잡초들입니다. 우리는 남부의 성가신 '피그위드'(그리고 다른 잡초들)가 얼마나 빨리 돌연변이를 일으켜 글리포세이트에 대한 저항성을 갖게 될지 몰랐습니다.

물론 농부들은 잡초를 손쉽게 제어할 수 있어 몇 년은 잘 해냈지만 그것은 오래가지 않았고 지금 상황은 이전보다 더 나빠졌습니다. 오늘날 모든 농부는 '팔머 아마란스(피그위드)'에 대해 잘 알고 있습니다. 글리포세이트를 거의 쏟아부어도 여전히 잘 자랍니다. 이 잡초들은 매우 빠르게 돌연변이를 일으켜 저항성을 갖게 되었습니다.

저는 코로나 주사에 대해서도 비슷한 시나리오가 있다고 생각합니다. 저는 과학자는 아니지만 이 주사가 면역을 만들어내기보다 주로 증상을 줄이는 것으로 인정되므로, 이것이 코로나19 바이러스의 돌연변이를 오히려 가속화할 가능성이 높아 보입니다. 이것은 생명의 '생존을 위한 투쟁' 원리와 같은 보통의 현상처럼 보입니다.

이 주사가 시장에 너무나 빠르게 나온 것도 또 다른 우려입니다. 우리는 이로 인해 앞으로 무엇이 올지나 어떤 부작용이 있을지 충분히 알지 못합니다. 몇 차례의 추가 접종이 필요하게 될지 모릅니다. 현재 전 세계가 실험장처럼 느껴지고, 제 관찰로는 잘 작동하지 않는 것 같으며 주사를 맞은 많은 사람들이 그것을 진정으로 신뢰하지 않습니다. 감염된 사람들이 쌓은 면역은 주사의 보호력보다 훨씬 우수합니다. 우리는 어렸을 때 독감에 걸리면 우리 몸이 그 계통에 대한 면역을 형성한다는 것을 알고 자랐습니다. 이것이 창조주께서 우리를 설계하신 방식입니다. 개인적으로 알던 첫 코로나 확진자 중 한 명은 6개월의 면역이 있다고 들었다고 했습니다. 저는 어떻게 그렇게 빨리 계산했는지 궁금했습니다. 이것은 새로운 바이러스였고 우리는 이 바이러스에 대해 경험이 전혀 없었습니다. 또한 우리가 익히 알던 바이러스들은 그 계통에 대해 평생 면역을 주곤 했습니다. 그렇다면 이 결론 뒤에 어떤 과학이 있었습니까?

따라서 저는 예방 조치를 취하고 우리의 면역 체계를 강화하기 위해 할 수 있는 일을 하는 것이 훨씬 낫다고 생각합니다. 하나님이 우리에게 주신 이 몸을 관리하는 청지기가 되어야 함을 상기하기에 더없이 좋은 때입니다. 좋은 영양, 운동, 체중 감량 계획을 세우기에 적절한 시기입니다. 과체중이라면 이 재앙과 많은 다른 질병에 훨씬 더 취약합니다. 정기적으로 설탕 음료나 어떤 종류의 건강에 해로운 음식을 섭취한다면 그 습관을 끊고 설탕 섭취를 줄이기에 더없이 좋은 때입니다. 과체중이거나 신체적으로 상태가 좋지 않다면 지금보다 더 좋은 때는 없으니 몸을 훨씬 더 건강한 상태로 만들어 이 바이러스와 많은 다른 질병을 물리칠 수 있도록 하십시오.

제 믿음은 장기적으로 볼 때 이 몸이 스스로 이 바이러스로부터 보호할 면역을 형성하도록 하는 것이 더 안전하고 나을 것이라는 점입니다. 저는 이 병에 걸려 사망한 사람들이 있다는 것을 알고 있습니다. 이 사실을 경시하지 않으며, 그들의 죽음을 유감스럽게 생각합니다. 또한 우리는 그리스도인으로서 항상 우리의 삶을 하나님께 맡기고 생명 보존의 전체 그림을 기독교 윤리의 렌즈를 통해 바라보아야 한다고 믿습니다.

회복율이 대략 99% 정도인 질병이 전 세계적으로 이토록 큰 소란을 일으킨 것은 전례가 없습니다. 소셜 미디어의 발명 덕분이 아니었다면 이토록 많은 공황과 혼란은 없었을 것임을 우리는 압니다. 제가 가장 우려하는 것 중 하나는 우리가 앞으로 더 많은 것에 대해 '조건화'되고 있다는 점입니다. 누가 상상이나 했겠습니까, 한 인플루엔자 바이러스가 우리가 여행할 수 있는지, 식당에 갈 수 있는지, 공개 행사에 모일 수 있는지와 같은 여부의 기준이 되는 어떤 것을 전 세계적으로 추진하는 도구가 될 줄을. 그것은 하나님께서 언젠가 현실로 일어날 것이라 말씀하신 것과 이상하게 비슷하게 들립니다—그리고 그가 모든 자, 작은 자나 큰 자나, 부자나 가난한 자나, 자유한 자나 매인 자나를 그들의 오른손이나 그들의 이마에 표를 받게 하고: 그 외에는 아무도 사거나 팔지 못하게 하려 하더라; 복의나 약탈의 이름, 또는 그 이름의 수를 가진 자 외에는 –Revelation 13:16-17.

저는 짐승의 표에 대해 언급했다는 이유로 거의 조롱을 당한 적이 있습니다. 또 다른 사람들은 이 구절이 영적으로 해석되어 종말 시대의 정부 체제와는 아무런 관련이 없다고 생각합니다. 또 다른 이들은 신부(교회)가 이것보다 먼저 휴거될 것이므로 우리에게는 걱정할 것이 없다고 생각합니다. 이 중 어느 하나의 견해가 맞았으면 좋겠다는 생각을 하기도 합니다. 그러면 저는 조용히 모든 것이 잘되길 바라며 넘어갈 수 있을 텐데요.

제가 서둘러 말하건대 저는 이것이 '짐승의 표'라고 생각하지 않습니다. 다만 저는 이것이 그 사건에 한 걸음 더 다가가는 또 하나의 단계로 봅니다. 또한 이 글은 다른 신념을 조롱하려는 글도 아니고 특정 교리적 의제를 지지하기 위해 특정 성경 구절들을 끼워 맞추려는 시도도 아닙니다. 예를 들어 모든 믿는 자들이 종말 사건이 전개되기 전에 휴거되어 '큰 환난'을 면할 것이라는 생각처럼 말입니다—–마태복음 24:21 및 요한계시록 7:14 참조. 우리는 우리 사회가 전반적으로 받고 있는 '조건화'와 특히 이 주사에 대한 조건화를 눈뜨고 볼 때입니다. 이것을 하려는 많은 타당한 이유들이 있습니다—합리적으로 보이고, 과학을 부정하지 않으며, 심지어 접종을 받으면 더 좋은 증인이 될 수 있다는 말까지 들었습니다. 이런 식으로 우리는 우리의 경제적 도로를 계속 굴러가게 하기 위해 해야 할 일을 하도록 '조건화'되고 있습니다.

그러니 제가 부탁드리는 것은 우리가 어디로 향하고 있는지를 생각해 보라는 것입니다. 언젠가 하나님의 백성은 이 세상의 기차에서 뛰어내릴 필요가 있을 것입니다—이러므로 그들 중에서 나오라, 너희는 구별되라, 주께서 말씀하시되 더러운 것을 만지지 말라 내가 너희를 영접하리라 –고린도후서 6:17. 요한계시록 14:10-11은 표를 받는 모든 자가 자기의 운명을 지옥에서 봉인할 것이라고 선언합니다. 다음 구절은 성도들의 인내를 부르짖습니다—여기 인내하는 성도들이라: 그들은 하나님의 계명들을 지키며 예수에 대한 믿음을 지키는 자들이니라 –요한계시록 14:12.

어려운 때가 있을 것입니다—마태복음 24:4-28을 읽어라. 기근과 전염병과 지진들이 약속되어 올 것임을 생각해 보십시오. 예수님은 이 모든 것이 '근심의 시작'이라고 말씀하셨습니다—말하자면 출산의 진통들입니다. 그는 이와 함께 '끝은 아직 아니다'라고도 하셨습니다. 그럼에도 우리는 승리의 약속을 갖고 있습니다—그들이 어린 양의 피와 자기들의 증언의 말씀으로 그를 이겼고, 또한 그들은 죽기까지 자기 생명을 사랑하지 아니하였더라 –요한계시록 12:11. 다시 말하건대, "언젠가 성도들은 경제적 기차에서 뛰어내려야 할 것이다"라고 저는 말합니다.

지금은 우리가 이 세상에 얼마나 매여 있는지 아니면 장차 받을 하늘의 상에 더 매여 있는지를 평가하기에 더없이 좋은 때라고 생각합니다. 우리 속히 오실 주요 왕과 더불어 동일시하겠다는 결단을 새롭게 합시다. 또한 창조주로부터 멀어지려는 사회에 예수의 왕국 복음을 전하기에 더없이 좋은 시간입니다.

그러므로 지금은 하나님이 창조하신 대로 제 몸에 있는 면역을 신뢰하며 안전하다고 느끼는 것이 만족스럽고, 또한 죄와 악의 길로부터 면역을 얻고 하늘로부터의 성령으로 접종될 것을 새롭게 결심하는 시간이 되었습니다. 당신도 이 결단에 함께하겠습니까?
